A Pigna ci occupiamo di persone con disabilità con cuore e professionalità. Sosteniamo, supportiamo, cura e cura. Con questo scopo, offriamo 148 posti di vita in varie forme di vita e 175 posti di lavoro protetti. Inoltre, 90 posti sono disponibili nel centro diurno. A partire dal 1° novembre 2026 o d'accordo, stiamo cercando un PROCURO MEDIUM FACHPERSON (50%) (F/M/D) Focus Foundation Fundraising La vostra area di responsabilità
• Sviluppo di una gestione della dotazione strutturata e sviluppo a medio termine di un programma di eredità strutturato, sviluppo di una cultura di apprezzamento e conservazione a lungo termine degli sponsor
• Ricerca sistematica e qualificazione delle fondazioni di finanziamento rilevanti (regionali e nazionali), nonché identificazione delle imprese della regione e creazione di relazioni per una partnership, creazione di un viaggio donatore e garanzia di reportistica e contabilità
• Preparazione e presentazione delle domande di sovvenzione in consultazione con il dipartimento e la gestione
• Il pensiero attivo, che le offerte esistenti e future per le basi di finanziamento potrebbero essere interessanti
• Analisi del rifiuto e del feedback per l'ottimizzazione continua delle applicazioni
• Cooperazione con i responsabili della comunicazione nell'attuazione della strategia di comunicazione con un focus chiaro sulla raccolta fondi
• Formazione in marketing / amministrazione aziendale / gestione del progetto e ulteriore formazione nella raccolta fondi (ad esempio ZHAW, CEPS Basel o simili)
• Obbligatorio almeno 2-3 anni di esperienza professionale nella raccolta fondi nell'area NPO e comprovata esperienza nella preparazione di domande di sovvenzione alle fondazioni, nonché report di progetto
• competenza in tedesco (lingua madre o C2); La conoscenza del francese e dell'inglese è vantaggiosa (per la gestione dei rapporti con i partner di supporto internazionali della regione)
• Elevate prestazioni e competenze sociali, nonché il godimento di lavorare con diversi stakeholder
• Esperienza nella gestione delle relazioni promozionali
• L'esperienza nel settore sociale e il collegamento con la regione Zurigo Unterland/Glattal è un vantaggio chiaro
Vi offriamo un'attività significativa e varia con molta responsabilità e grande portata creativa. Il lavoro può crescere con la funzione di raccolta fondi. Si può aspettare un team impegnato e apprezzativo, una cultura di leadership di supporto e condizioni di lavoro attraenti con una vasta gamma di benefici, tra cui il congedo di rigenerazione a pagamento, il venerdì supplementare e una vasta gamma di opportunità di formazione. Ulteriori vantaggi si possono trovare sulla nostra homepage: www.pigna.ch
Ti senti indirizzato?
Quindi fare clic su "Applica" e inviarci i documenti di applicazione completi incl. Affidabilità. Se hai domande aperte, contatta Carmen Feller, Responsabile Comunicazione e Fundraising al 044 800 75 13 (lunedì, martedì, giovedì). Nota: Nel processo di reclutamento, utilizziamo il supporto esterno da stiftung.ch.
descriptionByLocale.en:
• You combine your professional experience with real commitment to people and want to shape the institutional fundraising of our foundation from the ground up? At Pigna, we take care of people with disabilities with heart and professionalism. We support, support, care and care. For this purpose, we offer 148 living places in various forms of living as well as 175 protected workplaces. In addition, 90 seats are available in the day care center. As of 1 November 2026 or by agreement, we are looking for a FACHPERSON MEDIUM PROCUREMENT (50%) (F/M/D) Focus Foundation Fundraising Your area of responsibility
• Development of a structured endowment management as well as medium-term development of a structured legacy program, development of a culture of appreciation and long-term retention of sponsors
• Systematic research and qualification of relevant funding foundations (regional and national), as well as identification of companies from the region and establishing relationships for a partnership, establishing a donor journey and ensuring reporting and accounting
• Preparation and submission of grant applications in consultation with departmental and management
• Active thinking, which existing and future offers for funding foundations could be interesting
• Analysis of rejection and feedback for continuous application optimization
• Cooperation with the communication managers in the implementation of the communication strategy with a clear focus on fundraising
• Training in marketing / business administration / project management and further education in fundraising (e.g. ZHAW, CEPS Basel or comparable)
• Obligatory at least 2-3 years of professional experience in fundraising in the NPO area and proven experience in preparing grant applications to foundations as well as project reports
• proficiency in German (mother tongue or C2); Knowledge of French and English is advantageous (for relationship management with international support partners from the region)
• High performance and social competence, as well as enjoyment of working with different stakeholders
• Experience in managing promotional relationships
• Experience in the social sector and connection with the region Zurich Unterland/Glattal is a clear plus
We offer you a meaningful and varied activity with a lot of responsibility and great creative scope. The job can grow with the fundraising function. You can expect a committed and appreciative team, a supportive leadership culture and attractive employment conditions with a wide range of benefits, including paid regeneration leave, additional Fridays and a wide range of training opportunities. Further benefits can be found on our homepage: www.pigna.ch
Do you feel addressed?
Then click on "Apply" and send us your complete application documents incl. Rewardability. If you have any open questions, please contact Carmen Feller, Head of Communication and Fundraising at 044 800 75 13 (Mondays, Tuesdays, Thursdays). Note: In the recruitment process, we use external support from stiftung.ch.

Fühlst du dich angesprochen?

descriptionByLocale.de:
Zur Verstärkung unseres stark wachsenden Data Center Teams suchen wir dich als engagierte Persönlichkeit im Bereich Health & Safety Supervision (m/w/d) . Mit deiner Leidenschaft für Arbeitssicherheit und Gesundheitsschutz trägst du aktiv dazu bei, eine erstklassige Sicherheitskultur auf komplexen und anspruchsvollen Mission-Critical-Projekten aufzubauen, weiterzuentwickeln und nachhaltig zu verankern. In dieser vielseitigen und verantwortungsvollen Funktion unterstützt und überwachst du sämtliche Aktivitäten im Bereich Gesundheit, Sicherheit und Umwelt (HSE) auf der Baustelle. Dabei stellst du die Einhaltung der schweizerischen gesetzlichen Vorgaben, der Kundenanforderungen sowie der hohen HSE-Standards von Implenia sicher. Du arbeitest eng mit der Projektleitung, unseren Nachunternehmern sowie Vertretern der Bauherrschaft zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass Sicherheit in jeder Projektphase höchste Priorität geniesst. Zu deinem Aufgabenbereich gehören unter anderem die Durchführung von Sicherheitsinspektionen, das Management und die Betreuung von Nachunternehmern, die Erstellung und Überprüfung von Gefährdungsbeurteilungen, die Organisation und Durchführung von Schulungen, die Untersuchung von Vorfällen sowie die Mitwirkung bei der Notfall- und Krisenvorsorge. Dabei leistest du einen entscheidenden Beitrag zum erfolgreichen und sicheren Ablauf unserer internationalen Data-Center-Projekte. Dein vertraglicher Arbeitsort ist unser Hauptsitz „Connect“ in Opfikon. Du wirst jedoch überwiegend auf einem unserer Data-Center-Bauprojekte in der Region Zürich tätig sein. • Du förderst und lebst eine proaktive Sicherheitskultur auf unseren Data-Center-Baustellen und stellst die Einhaltung der Implenia HSE-Standards, der Kundenanforderungen sowie der gesetzlichen Vorgaben sicher
• Du bist regelmässig vor Ort präsent, unterstützt unsere Nachunternehmer in allen Sicherheitsfragen und sorgst dafür, dass definierte HSE-Standards konsequent umgesetzt werden

• Du untersuchst Vorfälle und Beinaheunfälle, führst Ursachenanalysen durch, leitest tägliche HSE-Briefings und Schulungen, berätst Projektbeteiligte und unterstützt die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Sicherheitsstandards und Prozesse Anforderungen Welche Anforderungen bringst du als Health & Safety Supervisor (m/w/d) mit?

To strengthen our rapidly growing Data Center team, we are looking for you as a committed personality in the field of Health & Safety Supervision (m/f/d). With your passion for occupational safety and health protection, you actively contribute to building, developing and sustainably anchoring a world-class safety culture on complex and challenging mission-critical projects. In this versatile and responsible function, you support and monitor all health, safety and environment (HSE) activities on the construction site. In doing so, you ensure compliance with Swiss legal requirements, customer requirements and Implenia’s high HSE standards. You work closely with the project management, our subcontractors and representatives of the building owner and ensure that safety is a top priority in every project phase. Your responsibilities include conducting security inspections, managing and supporting subcontractors, preparing and reviewing hazard assessments, organizing and conducting training, investigating incidents, and participating in emergency and crisis preparedness. You make a decisive contribution to the successful and secure running of our international data center projects. Your contractual place of work is our headquarters “Connect” in Opfikon. However, you will mainly work on one of our data center construction projects in the Zurich region. What tasks await you as Health & Safety Supervisor (m/f/d)?
• You promote and live a proactive security culture on our data center construction sites and ensure compliance with Implenia HSE standards, customer requirements and legal requirements
• You are regularly present on site, support our subcontractors in all security issues and ensure that defined HSE standards are consistently implemented
• You will conduct safety inspections, audits, inspections and hazard assessments, identify risks early and initiate appropriate corrective and prevention measures
• You coordinate and monitor the security performance of our subcontractors, check work permits, RAMS/WMS, security documentation and toolbox talks and accompany the corresponding processes
• You will investigate incidents and near-accidents, carry out root cause analyses, conduct daily HSE briefings and training, advise project participants and support the continuous development of our safety standards and processes Requirements What requirements do you bring as Health & Safety Supervisor (m/f/d)?
• Completed training in occupational safety, health, construction site safety or equivalent recognised qualification
• Several years of professional experience in a comparable HSE function on complex large-scale projects, ideally in data center, industrial, infrastructure or pharmaceutical construction
• In-depth knowledge in the areas of risk management, construction site safety, subcontractor management as well as work release and approval processes on demanding construction sites
• High social and communication skills combined with a sovereign appearance and the ability to sustainably promote security awareness at all hierarchical levels
• Independent, structured and solution-oriented working method
• Very good knowledge of English and ideally knowledge of German
• Recognized HSE certifications such as NEBOSH, SUVA or ISO 45001 Benefits
• A multicultural working environment with the chance to shape a future worth living in
• State-of-the-art technologies and a contemporary workplace at a sustainable company
• A company that promotes talent and the training of its employees
• The security of a financially healthy, broad-based group with strong roots in Switzerland
• Flexible working models with up to 40% home office
• Excellent travel insurance for you and those living in the same household
• An exciting selection of benefits:
• 5 weeks of vacation (6 weeks from age 50) and 9 paid bridge days
• an in-house pension fund with very good coverage and 3 contribution levels
• numerous discounts on well-known suppliers of products and services Why our employees like to work for us, they tell you themselves in the following video: https://youtu.be/wtuhlIfjJq8. • Online application with CV

descriptionByLocale.en:
In this role, you actively shape the future of sustainable building. You take on varied tasks with high professional standards. Which tasks await you as Project Manager Building Physics & Sustainability (m/f/d)?
• You lead projects in sustainable construction and building physics independently and implement them successfully.
• You create calculations and proofs, from energy proofs and thermal bridge calculations to life cycle assessments (LCA) and the associated documentation.
• You perform measurements, for example on indoor air quality, and create simulations.
• On construction sites, you take over control courses and carry out quality checks.
• You advise and accompany planners and other project participants in building physics and sustainability-related requirements.
• In new and existing construction projects, you are responsible for topics such as thermal comfort, humidity protection, airtightness, daylight and optionally building acoustics.
• You carry out sustainability certifications such as SNBS, Minergie, Minergie-ECO, DGNB, LEED, WELL or BREEAM and accompany the entire process.
• You like to share your knowledge and experience with less experienced team members.
• In cooperation with highly qualified specialists, you will continuously develop your own skills. What requirements do you bring as Project Manager Building Physics & Sustainability (m/f/d)?
• You have a relevant education or study, for example in civil engineering or building physics. Further training in the field of sustainability is beneficial.
• You share our enthusiasm for a sustainable construction industry and like to delve into new technical topics.
• Collaboration in the team is important to you and you focus on joint project success. Benefits
• A multicultural working environment with the chance to shape a future worth living in
• State-of-the-art technologies and a contemporary workplace at a sustainable company
• A company that promotes talent and the training of its employees
• The security of a financially healthy, broad-based group with strong roots in Switzerland
• Flexible working models with up to 40% home office
• Excellent travel insurance for you and those living in the same household
• An exciting selection of benefits:
• 5 weeks of vacation (6 weeks from age 50) and 9 paid bridge days
• an in-house pension fund with very good coverage and 3 contribution levels
• numerous discounts on well-known suppliers of products and services How does the application process at Encira work? At Encira you can expect a simple and transparent application process:
• Online application with CV
• Personal initial call by telephone, digitally or on site
• Second meeting and offer phase What is still important to us At Encira we value and live diversity. Our recruitment process is therefore focused on promoting diversity, equality and inclusion. Encira is part of Implenia Encira is the Implenia Group’s design and consulting company for acoustics, building physics, sustainability and energy. We accompany construction projects from the first idea to realization and develop practical solutions for clients, architects and planning teams. More information at encira.ch. As a leading Swiss construction and real estate service provider, Implenia develops, realizes and manages living spaces, working environments and infrastructure for future generations in Switzerland and Germany. Implenia also offers tunnelling and related infrastructure projects in other markets. The company combines the know-how of highly qualified consulting, development, planning and execution units under one roof into an integrated, multinationally leading construction and real estate service provider. Headquartered in Opfikon near Zurich, Implenia employs more than 8,000 people (FTE) across Europe and achieved a turnover of CHF 3.5 billion in 2025. More information at implenia.com.

• Vous effectuez des mesures, par exemple sur la qualité de l'air intérieur, et créez des simulations.

• Vous aimez partager vos connaissances et votre expérience avec des membres moins expérimentés de l'équipe.
• En collaboration avec des spécialistes hautement qualifiés, vous développerez continuellement vos propres compétences. Quelles exigences apportez-vous en tant que Project Manager Building Physics & Sustainability (h/f/d)?
• Vous avez une formation ou une étude pertinente, par exemple en génie civil ou en physique du bâtiment. La formation continue dans le domaine de la durabilité est bénéfique.
• Vous partagez notre enthousiasme pour une industrie de la construction durable et aimez approfondir de nouveaux sujets techniques.
• La collaboration au sein de l'équipe est importante pour vous et vous vous concentrez sur la réussite de projets conjoints. Avantages
• Un environnement de travail multiculturel avec la possibilité de façonner un futur qui mérite d'être vécu
• Technologies de pointe et lieu de travail contemporain dans une entreprise durable
• Une entreprise qui promeut le talent et la formation de ses employés
• La sécurité d'un groupe en bonne santé financière et à base large ayant de solides racines en Suisse
• Modèles de travail flexibles avec jusqu'à 40% de bureau à domicile
• Excellente assurance voyage pour vous et ceux qui vivent dans le même ménage
• Une sélection passionnante de bénéfices:
• 5 semaines de vacances (6 semaines à partir de 50 ans) et 9 jours de pont payés
• un fonds de pension interne avec une très bonne couverture et 3 niveaux de cotisation
• de nombreux rabais sur les fournisseurs connus de produits et services Comment fonctionne le processus de demande chez Encira? Chez Encira vous pouvez vous attendre à un processus de demande simple et transparent:
• Demande en ligne avec CV
• Appel personnel initial par téléphone, numériquement ou sur place
• Deuxième réunion et phase d ' offre Ce qui est encore important pour nous Chez Encira, nous apprécions et vivons la diversité. Notre processus de recrutement est donc axé sur la promotion de la diversité, de l'égalité et de l'inclusion. Encira fait partie d'Implenia Encira est la société de conception et de conseil d'Implenia Group pour l'acoustique, la physique du bâtiment, la durabilité et l'énergie. Implenia propose également des projets de tunnel et d'infrastructures connexes sur d'autres marchés. La société combine le savoir-faire d'unités hautement qualifiées de conseil, de développement, de planification et d'exécution sous un même toit en un fournisseur intégré de services de construction et d'immobilier de premier plan. Basée à Opfikon près de Zurich, Implenia emploie plus de 8 000 personnes (ETP) en Europe et a réalisé un chiffre d'affaires de 3,5 milliards de CHF en 2025. Plus d'informations sur implenia.com.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Nel team Portal, siamo il cuore dell’esperienza di Sygnum, che si rivolge ai clienti, e il nostro lavoro influisce direttamente sul modo in cui gli utenti interagiscono con i loro beni digitali. La nostra missione è quella di creare soluzioni UI/UX all'avanguardia che non solo soddisfano ma superano le aspettative dei clienti, mantenendo le loro esigenze al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo. Collaboriamo a stretto contatto con i team Custody, Trading, Tokenization e Banking Operations per garantire che le nostre applicazioni siano robuste, sicure e all'avanguardia. Ma siamo più che colleghi, siamo una comunità vibrante che valorizza creatività, innovazione e divertimento. Crediamo che un ambiente di lavoro favorevole e piacevole favorisca la collaborazione, la fiducia e la risoluzione proattiva dei problemi. Il miglioramento continuo è nel nostro DNA; ci affidiamo a informazioni basate sui dati per affinare i nostri approcci e fornire l'eccellenza. Unisciti a noi significa essere parte di un team che è così impegnato per la qualità e l'esperienza utente in quanto è quello di creare un posto di lavoro che ti piace venire ogni giorno. Come guida tecnologica, sei comodo indossare due cappelli: tecnologia e gestione. Da una prospettiva tecnica, si:
• Guidare un team di ingegneri software per sviluppare e possedere soluzioni all'avanguardia (front e back-end).
• Migliora costantemente la qualità e la sicurezza delle applicazioni.
• Collabora con Design per migliorare i nostri prodotti centrici client.
• Contribuire alla scrittura e alla revisione di alta qualità e codice protetto coperto da test.
• Lavora con gli ingegneri SRE e gli architetti di soluzioni per migliorare la disponibilità, la resilienza e l'osservanza delle applicazioni. Da una prospettiva manageriale, si:
• Gli ingegneri del software di coach e mentore nella squadra.
• Migliorare l'efficienza e l'efficacia del team.
• Partner con product manager e stakeholder per pianificare nuove funzionalità e miglioramenti.
• Guida retrò e post-mortem senza colpa che aiutano la squadra a imparare dagli errori.
• Promuovere uno spazio psicologicamente sicuro dove tutti sentono di poter contribuire e migliorare le cose.
• Fluency in JavaScript, TypeScript, React e Nestjs.
• Progettazione di componenti riutilizzabili ed estensibili per più progetti.
• Esperienza e riferimenti come Ingegnere Frontend in configurazioni complesse.
• Comprendere UI & UX per cercare la migliore esperienza per l'utente
• Conoscenza della preparazione dei dati, prima API e isolamento dei concetti
• Comprendere il ciclo di vita di sviluppo e le sue tecnologie – Git, strumenti CI/CD, test di unità, vulnerabilità.
• Competenza sulle strutture agili (Scrum, kanban...).
• Sei impaziente di lavorare con FE e BE.
• Ti piace fare entrambi: lavoro di leadership tecnico e personale.
• Hai una mentalità collaborativa e di crescita.
• Ti importa di qualità e sicurezza e cuocere quegli aspetti nel ciclo di vita dello sviluppo software.
• Sei a tuo agio a prendere la proprietà di tutto il ciclo di vita di sviluppo, dalla progettazione di soluzioni per l'esecuzione dell'applicazione in produzione.
• Sei proattivo e motivati con nuove opportunità e sfide. Unirsi a Sygnum significa essere parte di un team dinamico e globale che sta costruendo un gateway affidabile tra le economie di asset tradizionali e digitali. Lavorando a Sygnum, sperimenterete il nostro ambiente di lavoro veloce ed emozionante che abbraccia la meritocrazia e la collaborazione e la comunicazione aperta. Accanto alla nostra ambiziosa missione a lungo termine, ci uniamo anche per raggiungere importanti pietre miliari e anniversari cripto-industriali annuali come Bitcoin Pizza Day, e regolarmente celebrare insieme a eventi aziendali a tema come parte del nostro viaggio per formare Future Finance. Sygnum offre un pacchetto completo di vantaggi per tutti i membri del team. Essi includono:
• Combinazione attraente di salari di mercato e di incentivazione imprenditoriale
• Flessibile / Lavoro nelle politiche domestiche
• Sviluppo professionale tramite programmi Mentoring e Buddy
• Un mese completamente pagato sabbatico dopo cinque anni di lavoro continuo Se siete appassionati del potenziale di blockchain per modellare Future Finance e il vostro profilo è una buona misura per questa posizione, si prega di inviare il vostro CV oggi!
descriptionByLocale.en:
At the Portal team, we’re the heart of Sygnum’s client-facing experience, and our work directly impacts how users interact with their digital assets. Our mission is to create state-of-the-art UI/UX solutions that not only meet but exceed client expectations, keeping their needs at the center of everything we do. We collaborate closely with Custody, Trading, Tokenization, and Banking Operations teams to ensure our applications are robust, secure, and cutting-edge. But we’re more than just colleagues, we’re a vibrant community that values creativity, innovation, and fun. We believe a supportive and enjoyable work environment fosters collaboration, trust, and proactive problem-solving. Continuous improvement is in our DNA; we rely on data-driven insights to refine our approaches and deliver excellence. Joining us means being part of a team that’s as committed to quality and user experience as it is to create a workplace you’ll love coming to every day. As a tech lead, you are comfortable wearing two hats: tech and management. From a technical perspective, you will:
• Lead a team of software engineers to develop and own state-of-the-art solutions (front and back end).
• Constantly enhance quality and security of the applications.
• Collaborate with Design to improve our client centric products.
• Contribute to writing and reviewing high quality and secured code covered by tests.
• Work with SRE engineers and solution architects to improve the availability, resilience, and observability of the applications. From a managerial perspective, you will:
• Coach and mentor software engineers in the team.
• Improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the team.
• Partner with product managers and stakeholders to plan new features and improvements.
• Drive blameless retros and post-mortems that help the team learn from mistakes.
• Promote a psychologically safe space where everyone feels they can contribute and improve things.
• Fluency in JavaScript, TypeScript, React and Nestjs.
• Designing reusable and extendable components for multiple projects.
• Experience and references as a Frontend Engineer in complex setups.
• Understanding UI & UX to seek the best experience for the user
• Knowledge about data preparation, API first and concept isolation
• Understanding the development lifecycle and its technologies – Git, CI/CD tools, unit testing, vulnerability.
• Expertise on agile frameworks (Scrum, kanban...).
• You are eager to work with FE and BE.
• You enjoy doing both: technical and people leadership work.
• You have a collaborative and growth mindset.
• You care about quality and security and bake those aspects in the software development lifecycle.
• You are comfortable taking ownership of the whole development lifecycle, from designing solutions to running the application in production.
• You are proactive and get motivated with new opportunities and challenges. Joining Sygnum means being part of a dynamic, global team that is building a trusted gateway between the traditional and digital asset economies. Working at Sygnum, you will experience our fast-paced, exciting work environment that embraces meritocracy and collaboration and open communication. Alongside our ambitious long-term mission, we also come together for reaching important milestones and annual crypto-industry anniversaries like Bitcoin Pizza Day, and regularly celebrate together at themed company events as part of our journey to shape Future Finance. Sygnum offers a comprehensive package of benefits for all team members. They include:
• Attractive combination of market salaries and entrepreneurial incentive scheme
• Flexible/Work at home policies
• Professional development via Mentoring and Buddy programs
• One-month fully paid sabbatical after five years of continuous employment If you are passionate about the potential of blockchain to shape Future Finance and your profile is a good fit for this position, please send us your CV today!

descriptionByLocale.it:
Vuoi la libertà del lavoro temporaneo e la sicurezza di un impiego a tempo indeterminato? Da 30 anni affianchiamo centinaia di aziende nei settori tecnici dell’edilizia, delle costruzioni e dell’industria in tutta la Svizzera, proponendo loro i migliori talenti. Non ti nascondiamo però che siamo esigenti. Quindi, se sei una persona motivata ed estremamente entusiasta, entra a far parte del nostro team per la posizione di Responsabile di progetto nel settore elettrico – È richiesto il diploma federale di esperto.

## Il tuo ruolo:
In qualità di responsabile di progetto nel settore elettrico, ricopri una funzione essenzialmente operativa e a stretto contatto con il campo. Dirigi le squadre, coordini gli interventi e partecipi attivamente al monitoraggio tecnico degli impianti.

Sei in possesso di un attestato federale nel settore elettrico. Un diploma federale di esperto in impianti e sicurezza elettrica costituisce un serio vantaggio.
Hai maturato una comprovata esperienza in Svizzera in qualità di caposquadra, responsabile di officina, capocantiere o responsabile di squadra.

Ami e padroneggi il tuo mestiere e vuoi mettere le tue competenze al servizio di progetti che contano davvero?
Allora questa offerta è fatta apposta per te.
Da noi, la tua competenza fa la differenza e contribuisce direttamente al successo dei cantieri.

> A Proton, crediamo che la privacy sia un diritto umano fondamentale e la pietra angolare della democrazia. Fin dalla nostra nascita nel 2014, fondata da un team di scienziati del CERN, ci siamo dedicati a fornire tecnologia gratuita e open source a milioni di persone in tutto il mondo, garantendo l'accesso alla privacy, alla sicurezza e alla libertà online. > Il nostro viaggio è iniziato con Proton Mail, il più grande servizio di posta elettronica sicuro a livello globale, e da allora ha ampliato per includere Proton VPN, Proton Calendar, Proton Drive e Proton Pass. Questi strumenti consentono agli individui e alle organizzazioni di prendere il controllo dei propri dati personali, di allontanarsi dalle pratiche invasive di Big Tech e di sconfiggere la censura. Il nostro lavoro colpisce centinaia di milioni di vite, dagli attivisti sulle prime linee di difesa della libertà ai leader nei governi che proteggono le informazioni sensibili. In alcuni casi, i servizi di Proton sono stati anche strumentali nel salvare vite, consentendo comunicazioni sicure e private in situazioni ad alto rischio. > Proton è una società redditizia che non si affida ai finanziamenti VC, supportando oltre 100 milioni di account utente con un team crescente di oltre 500 persone provenienti da oltre 50 paesi diversi, dalle migliori aziende e università del mondo. Apprezziamo l'intelligenza, il potenziale di apprendimento e l'ambizione nel nostro processo di assunzione. descriptionByLocale.en:
Join Proton and build a better internet where privacy is the default

At Proton, we believe that privacy is a fundamental human right and the cornerstone of democracy. Since our inception in 2014, founded by a team of scientists from CERN, we have dedicated ourselves to providing free and open-source technology to millions worldwide, ensuring access to privacy, security, and freedom online.

Our journey began with Proton Mail, the largest secure email service globally, and has since expanded to include Proton VPN, Proton Calendar, Proton Drive, and Proton Pass. These tools empower individuals and organizations to take control of their personal data, break away from Big Tech’s invasive practices, and defeat censorship. Our work impacts hundreds of millions of lives, from activists on the front lines defending freedom to leaders in governments protecting sensitive information. In some cases, Proton’s services have even been instrumental in saving lives by enabling secure and private communications in high-risk situations.

Proton is a profitable company that does not rely upon VC funding, supporting over 100 million user accounts with a growing team of over 500 people from over 50 different countries, from the world's top companies and universities. We value intelligence, learning potential, and ambition in our hiring process. Adaptability is key as we navigate uncharted territories and redefine how business is conducted online.

Hiring at Proton is highly selective, with less than 1% of candidates hired. We believe smaller teams of exceptional talent will always prevail over larger teams with lower talent density. You will have the opportunity work with many of the world's top minds in their fields, ranging from former international math and science olympiad winners to chess champions.

We have a global mindset and big ambitions but remain a start-up at heart. We value empowerment and flexibility and keep our structure flat to keep moving fast and avoid unnecessary politics. Tired of blending into the crowd? Join us and do work you can truly be proud of. Check our open-source projects here!

The Design Team

Proton's Design team shapes the experience for tens of millions of users across Mail, Drive, VPN, Pass, and Calendar. Designers sit embedded within engineering teams, involved in every stage — ceremonies, scoping, implementation, and testing — not parachuted in at the mockup phase. The team is structured as a guild: high autonomy, significant ownership, and real influence over how the design function itself evolves. We work cross-functionally across product, engineering, and marketing, and we care deeply about visual craft. We're not looking for designers who've drifted toward pure strategy or metrics — this role demands someone who still loves getting their hands dirty and takes personal pride in what ships. If that's where you do your best work, you'll fit here.

•
•
What you will do
•
  • Own design end-to-end across one or more product areas — from scoping and ideation through final specs and QA with engineers
  • Translate complex privacy and security constraints into experiences that feel simple and trustworthy to non-technical users
    • •
  • Identify UX debt and product gaps with clear recommendations, not just problem statements
    • •
  • Contribute to and enforce the Proton Design System — icons, components, interaction patterns, and visual standards
    • •
  • Work directly with engineers to pressure-test designs against technical constraints before and during build
    • •
  • Define micro-interactions and transitions that serve clarity and feel premium without adding complexity
    • •
•

•
Job requirements
Who You Are
•

•
  • 5+ years designing and shipping digital products at scale in a SaaS or tech company — a portfolio demonstrating this is required
  • Proven ability to deliver end-to-end: concept, flow, visual execution, and handoff — not just high-fidelity mockups
  • Deep command of visual craft: typography, layout, spacing, color, and hierarchy at a level that raises the bar for everyone around you
  • Fluent working within technical constraints — you've shipped work that required real trade-offs with engineering, and you pushed for the right outcomes anyway
    • •
  • Experience contributing to a living design system, not just consuming one
    • •
  • Comfortable articulating design rationale to engineers, PMs, and leadership without relying on consensus-seeking
    • •
•

Nice to Have

•
    •
  • Experience with Rand or comparable large-scale UX research methods
    • •
  • Background designing privacy-respecting alternatives to mainstream social or community platforms
    • •
•

•

What We Offer:

•
  • Office First: Collaboration is easier and more effective in person, which is why we have offices in Geneva, Zurich, Prague, Barcelona, Paris, London, Vilnius, Skopje, and Taipei. You can also enjoy working from home up to 30% of the time, while enjoying great company during our three core days in the office.
  • Technology: We provide all the devices and software you need to excel in your role, ensuring you have the best tools at your disposal to achieve your goals.
  • Food: Lunch and snacks are provided by Proton every day at our offices.
  • Transport: We will always support our employees with transport costs through subsidizing public transport, bike allowances, or parking spaces based on your office location.
  • Stock Options: At Proton, we are all owners of the company and you get stock options when you join us.
  • Flexible Working: You can define your own working hours as long as it works with team meetings.
  • Learning and Development: We are committed to your professional growth. Proton offers various learning opportunities, including training programs, conferences and events, and continual learning.
  • Employee Benefits: Comprehensive health insurance plans, competitive retirement savings options, generous vacation and leave policies, and wellness programs.
  • Work that Matters: Proton is a community-first organization, started with the support of a crowdfunding campaign and built with community input. To this day, Proton’s only source of revenue is user subscriptions. Over 100 million people trust and support Proton, and we put our users and community first in everything we do. Read more about our impact here.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At Proton, we believe diversity drives innovation and strengthens our mission to provide privacy as a default for all. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where all individuals, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, age, sexual orientation, physical ability, or socio-economic background, feel valued and empowered. We strive to create equal opportunities, promote open dialogue, and support continuous learning to ensure every voice is heard and respected.

If you need any extra support or reasonable adjustments during the hiring process, please let your talent partner know.

Candidate Privacy Notice

When you apply for a position, refer a candidate, or are considered for a role at Proton Technologies AG (Proton, we, us, or our), your information is stored in Greenhouse, in accordance with their Service Privacy Policy. This information is used to evaluate your suitability for the posted position. We also retain this information for consideration for future roles that you may apply for or that we believe may align with your background and skills.

If we no longer have a legitimate business need to process your information, we will either delete or anonymize it. Should you have any inquiries about how we use or manage your information, or if you wish to access, correct, or delete your data, please contact our privacy team at careers@proton.ch.

Proton does not accept unsolicited resumes from any sources other than directly from candidates. We will not pay a fee for any placement resulting from an unsolicited offer, even if the candidate is subsequently hired by Proton.

To learn more about our privacy policy, please visit our privacy policy page.

Gehen Sie Proton bei und bauen Sie ein besseres Internet auf, in dem Privatsphäre standardmäßig ist

Bei Proton glauben wir, dass Privatsphäre ein grundlegendes Menschenrecht und der Eckpfeiler der Demokratie ist. Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2014, gegründet von einem Team von Wissenschaftlern des CERN, haben wir uns der Bereitstellung von freien und Open-Source-Technologien für Millionen von Menschen weltweit verschrieben, um den Zugang zu Privatsphäre, Sicherheit und Freiheit online zu gewährleisten.

Unsere Reise begann mit Proton Mail, dem weltweit größten sicheren E-Mail-Dienst, und wurde seitdem um Proton VPN, Proton Kalender, Proton Drive und Proton Pass erweitert. Diese Tools ermöglichen es Einzelpersonen und Organisationen, die Kontrolle über ihre persönlichen Daten zu übernehmen, sich von den invasiven Praktiken von Big Tech zu lösen und die Zensur zu besiegen. Unsere Arbeit beeinflusst Hunderte von Millionen von Leben, von Aktivisten an vorderster Front, die die Freiheit verteidigen, bis hin zu Führern in Regierungen, die sensible Informationen schützen. In einigen Fällen haben die Dienste von Proton sogar dazu beigetragen, Leben zu retten, indem sie sichere und private Kommunikation in Hochrisikosituationen ermöglichten.

Proton ist ein profitables Unternehmen, das nicht auf VC-Finanzierung angewiesen ist und über 100 Millionen Benutzerkonten mit einem wachsenden Team von über 500 Mitarbeitern aus über 50 verschiedenen Ländern von den weltweit führenden Unternehmen und Universitäten unterstützt. Wir schätzen Intelligenz, Lernpotenzial und Ehrgeiz in unserem Einstellungsprozess. Anpassungsfähigkeit ist der Schlüssel, wenn wir durch unbekannte Gebiete navigieren und neu definieren, wie Geschäfte online abgewickelt werden.

Die Einstellung bei Proton ist sehr selektiv, wobei weniger als 1% der Kandidaten eingestellt werden. Wir glauben, dass kleinere Teams mit außergewöhnlichen Talenten sich immer gegen größere Teams mit geringerer Talentdichte durchsetzen werden. Sie haben die Möglichkeit, mit vielen der besten Köpfe der Welt in ihren Bereichen zu arbeiten, von ehemaligen internationalen Gewinnern der Mathematik und Wissenschaft bis hin zu Schachmeistern.

Wir haben eine globale Denkweise und große Ambitionen, bleiben aber ein Start-up im Herzen. Wir schätzen Empowerment und Flexibilität und halten unsere Struktur flach, um schnell zu bleiben und unnötige Politik zu vermeiden. Müde vom Mischen in die Menge? Begleiten Sie uns und machen Sie Arbeit, auf die Sie wirklich stolz sein können. Schauen Sie sich unsere open-source projects hier

Das Designteam

Das Design-Team von Proton gestaltet das Erlebnis für zig Millionen Nutzer in Mail, Drive, VPN, Pass und Kalender. Designer sitzen eingebettet in Engineering-Teams, die in jede Phase involviert sind - Zeremonien, Scoping, Implementierung und Test - und nicht in der Mockup-Phase mit Fallschirmen. Das Team ist als Gilde strukturiert: hohe Autonomie, erhebliches Eigentum und echter Einfluss darauf, wie sich die Designfunktion selbst entwickelt. Wir arbeiten funktionsübergreifend über Produkt, Engineering und Marketing hinweg und legen großen Wert auf visuelles Handwerk. Wir suchen nicht nach Designern, die sich in Richtung reiner Strategie oder Metriken bewegt haben - diese Rolle verlangt jemanden, der es immer noch liebt, sich die Hände schmutzig zu machen und persönlich stolz darauf zu sein, was Schiffe sind. Wenn du dort deine beste Arbeit machst, wirst du hier passen.

•
•
Was Sie tun werden
•
  • Eigenes Design Ende-zu-Ende in einem oder mehreren Produktbereichen - von Scoping und Ideation über endgültige Spezifikationen und QA mit Ingenieuren
  • Übersetzen Sie komplexe Datenschutz- und Sicherheitsbeschränkungen in Erlebnisse, die sich für nicht-technische Benutzer einfach und vertrauenswürdig anfühlen
    • •
  • Identifizieren Sie UX-Schulden und Produktlücken mit klaren Empfehlungen, nicht nur Problemerklärungen
    • •
  • Beitragen und erzwingen Sie das Proton Design System - Icons, Komponenten, Interaktionsmuster und visuelle Standards •
  • Arbeiten Sie direkt mit Ingenieuren zusammen, um Designs vor und während des Builds gegen technische Einschränkungen zu testen
    • •
  • Definieren Sie Mikrointeraktionen und Übergänge, die der Klarheit und dem Gefühl dienen, ohne Komplexität hinzuzufügen
    • •
•

•
Job requirements
Who You Are
•

•
  • 5+ Jahre Design und Versand digitaler Produkte in großem Maßstab in einem SaaS- oder Technologieunternehmen - ein Portfolio, das dies demonstriert, ist erforderlich
  • Bewährte Fähigkeit, Ende-zu-Ende zu liefern: Konzept, Fluss, visuelle Ausführung und Übergabe - nicht nur High-Fidelity-Mockups
  • Tiefe Beherrschung des visuellen Handwerks: Typografie, Layout, Abstand, Farbe und Hierarchie auf einer Ebene, die die Messlatte für alle um dich herum anhebt
  • Fließend arbeiten innerhalb technischer Zwänge - Sie haben Arbeiten geliefert, die echte Kompromisse mit dem Engineering erforderten, und Sie haben trotzdem auf die richtigen Ergebnisse gedrängt
    • •
  • Erfahrung, die zu einem lebenden Designsystem beiträgt und nicht nur eines konsumiert
    • •
  • Bequeme Artikulation von Design-Beweggründen für Ingenieure, PMs und Führung, ohne sich auf Konsenssuche zu verlassen •
•

Nice to Have

•
    •
  • Erfahrung mit Rand oder vergleichbaren UX-Großforschungsmethoden
    • •
  • Hintergrund Entwerfen von datenschutzgerechten Alternativen zu Mainstream-Social- oder Community-Plattformen
    • •
•

Sie können auch bis zu 30% der Zeit von zu Hause aus arbeiten und während unserer drei Kerntage im Büro eine großartige Gesellschaft genießen.

  • Lernen und Entwicklung: Wir setzen uns für Ihr berufliches Wachstum ein. Proton bietet verschiedene Lernmöglichkeiten, darunter Schulungsprogramme, Konferenzen und Veranstaltungen sowie kontinuierliches Lernen.

Über 100 millionen menschen vertrauen und unterstützen proton, und wir stellen unsere nutzer und unsere community an die erste stelle bei allem, was wir tun. Lesen Sie mehr über unsere Wirkung hier.

Bei Proton glauben wir, dass Vielfalt Innovationen vorantreibt und unsere Mission stärkt, Privatsphäre als Standard für alle zu bieten. descriptionByLocale.fr:
Rejoignez Proton et construisez un meilleur Internet où la confidentialité est la valeur par défaut

Chez Proton, nous croyons que la vie privée est un droit fondamental de l'homme et la pierre angulaire de la démocratie. Depuis notre création en 2014, fondée par une équipe de scientifiques du CERN, nous nous sommes engagés à fournir une technologie gratuite et ouverte à des millions de personnes dans le monde entier, assurant l'accès à la vie privée, à la sécurité et à la liberté en ligne.

Notre voyage a commencé avec Proton Mail, le plus grand service d'email sécurisé au monde, et s'est étendu depuis à Proton VPN, Proton Calendar, Proton Drive et Proton Pass. Ces outils permettent aux individus et aux organisations de prendre le contrôle de leurs données personnelles, de rompre avec les pratiques invasives de Big Tech et de vaincre la censure. Notre travail a des répercussions sur des centaines de millions de vies, des militants en première ligne qui défendent la liberté aux dirigeants des gouvernements qui protègent des informations sensibles. Dans certains cas, les services de Proton ont même contribué à sauver des vies en permettant des communications sécurisées et privées dans des situations à haut risque.

Proton est une entreprise rentable qui ne dépend pas du financement de CV, soutenant plus de 100 millions de comptes d'utilisateurs avec une équipe croissante de plus de 500 personnes de plus de 50 pays différents, des principales entreprises et universités du monde. Nous valorisons l'intelligence, le potentiel d'apprentissage et l'ambition dans notre processus d'embauche. L'adaptabilité est essentielle alors que nous naviguons dans des territoires inexplorés et redéfinissons la façon dont les affaires sont menées en ligne.

L'embauche chez Proton est très sélective, avec moins de 1% des candidats embauchés. Nous croyons que les équipes plus petites de talent exceptionnel prévaudront toujours sur les équipes plus grandes avec une densité de talent inférieure. Vous aurez l'occasion de travailler avec de nombreux meilleurs esprits du monde dans leurs domaines, allant des anciens gagnants internationaux de mathématiques et de sciences olympiades aux champions d'échecs.

Nous avons un état d'esprit global et de grandes ambitions mais restons une start-up au cœur. Nous valorisons l'autonomisation et la flexibilité et maintenons notre structure à plat pour continuer à avancer rapidement et éviter les politiques inutiles. Fatigué de se fondre dans la foule ? Rejoignez-nous et faites du travail dont vous pouvez vraiment être fier. Consultez nos open-source projets ici

L'équipe de conception

L'équipe de conception de Proton façonne l'expérience pour des dizaines de millions d'utilisateurs à travers Mail, Drive, VPN, Pass et Calendrier. Les concepteurs sont intégrés dans les équipes d'ingénieurs, impliqués dans toutes les étapes — cérémonies, cadrage, mise en œuvre et essais — qui ne sont pas parachutés à la phase de simulation. L'équipe est structurée comme une guilde : grande autonomie, appropriation significative et influence réelle sur le fonctionnement du design lui-même. Nous travaillons de façon interfonctionnelle sur les produits, l'ingénierie et le marketing, et nous nous intéressons profondément à l'artisanat visuel. Nous ne cherchons pas des designers qui ont dérivé vers une stratégie ou des mesures pures — ce rôle exige quelqu'un qui aime encore se salir les mains et prend la fierté personnelle de ce qui expédie. Si c'est là que vous faites votre meilleur travail, vous serez ici.

•
•
Ce que vous ferez
•
  • De bout en bout dans un ou plusieurs domaines de produits — de la portée et de l'idée jusqu'aux spécifications finales et à l'AQ avec les ingénieurs
  • Traduire des contraintes complexes en matière de confidentialité et de sécurité en expériences qui se sentent simples et dignes de confiance pour les utilisateurs non techniques
    • •
  • Cerner les lacunes en matière de dette et de produits UX avec des recommandations claires, et non seulement des énoncés de problèmes
    • •
  • Contribuer au Proton Design System — icônes, composants, modèles d'interaction et normes visuelles et les faire appliquer
    • •
  • Travailler directement avec les ingénieurs pour les essais de pression en fonction des contraintes techniques avant et pendant la construction
    • •
  • Définir les micro-interactions et les transitions qui servent à la clarté et à la sensation sans ajouter de complexité
    • •
•

•
Conditions d'emploi
Qui vous êtes
•

•
  • 5+ années de conception et d'expédition de produits numériques à l'échelle dans une entreprise de SaaS ou de technologie — un portefeuille démontrant cela est nécessaire
  • Aptitude éprouvée à livrer de bout en bout : concept, débit, exécution visuelle et remise – pas seulement des maquettes de haute fidélité
  • Commande profonde de l'artisanat visuel : typographie, mise en page, espacement, couleur et hiérarchie à un niveau qui élève la barre pour tout le monde autour de vous
  • Fonctionnant avec des contraintes techniques — vous avez expédié des travaux qui ont exigé de véritables compromis avec l'ingénierie, et vous avez poussé pour les bons résultats de toute façon
    • •
  • Expérience contribuant à un système de conception de la vie, pas seulement en consommant un
    • •
  • articulant confortablement la justification de la conception aux ingénieurs, aux PM et au leadership sans compter sur la recherche de consensus
    • •
•

Nice to Have

•
    •
  • Expérience avec Rand ou des méthodes de recherche comparables à grande échelle sur les UX
    • •
  • Contexte conception de solutions de rechange respectueuses de la vie privée aux plates-formes sociales ou communautaires générales
    • •
•

•

Ce que nous offrons:

•
  • Office First: La collaboration est plus facile et plus efficace en personne, c'est pourquoi nous avons des bureaux à Genève, Zurich, Prague, Barcelone, Paris, Londres, Vilnius, Skopje et Taipei. Vous pouvez également profiter de travailler de la maison jusqu'à 30% du temps, tout en profitant d'une grande entreprise pendant nos trois jours de base dans le bureau.
  • Technologie : Nous fournissons tous les appareils et les logiciels dont vous avez besoin pour exceller dans votre rôle, vous assurant d'avoir les meilleurs outils à votre disposition pour atteindre vos objectifs.
  • Food: Le déjeuner et les collations sont fournis par Proton tous les jours dans nos bureaux.
  • Transports : Nous soutiendrons toujours nos employés avec des frais de transport en subventionnant les transports en commun, les allocations de vélos ou les places de stationnement en fonction de l'emplacement de votre bureau.
  • Options de réserve: Chez Proton, nous sommes tous propriétaires de l'entreprise et vous obtenez des options d'achat d'actions lorsque vous vous joignez à nous.
  • Travail flexible : Vous pouvez définir vos propres heures de travail aussi longtemps que cela fonctionne avec les réunions d'équipe.
  • Apprendre et développer: Nous sommes engagés dans votre développement professionnel. Proton offre diverses possibilités d'apprentissage, notamment des programmes de formation, des conférences et des événements, et un apprentissage continu.
  • Prestations aux employés: Régimes complets d'assurance-maladie, options concurrentielles d'épargne-retraite, politiques généreuses en matière de congés annuels et de programmes de mieux-être.
  • Travail qui compte : Proton est un organisme communautaire d'abord, a commencé avec le soutien d'une campagne de financement participatif et construit avec l'apport de la communauté. À ce jour, la seule source de revenus de Proton est les abonnements utilisateurs. Plus de 100 millions de personnes font confiance et soutiennent Proton, et nous mettons nos utilisateurs et notre communauté en premier dans tout ce que nous faisons. En savoir plus sur notre impact ici.

Notre engagement envers la diversité et l'inclusion

Chez Proton, nous croyons que la diversité stimule l'innovation et renforce notre mission de fournir la vie privée comme un défaut pour tous. Nous nous engageons à favoriser un environnement inclusif où tous les individus, sans distinction de race, d'origine ethnique, de sexe, d'âge, d'orientation sexuelle, de capacité physique ou de contexte socioéconomique, se sentent valorisés et habilités. Nous nous efforçons de créer l'égalité des chances, de promouvoir un dialogue ouvert et d'appuyer l'apprentissage continu pour faire en sorte que chaque voix soit entendue et respectée.

Si vous avez besoin d'un soutien supplémentaire ou d'ajustements raisonnables pendant le processus d'embauche, veuillez en informer votre partenaire talentueux.

Avis de confidentialité obligatoire

Lorsque vous postulez à un poste, que vous soumettez un candidat ou que vous êtes considéré pour un rôle à Proton Technologies AG (Proton, nous, nous, ou notre), vos informations sont stockées à Greenhouse, conformément à leur Politique de confidentialité du service. Ces renseignements servent à évaluer votre aptitude au poste affiché. Nous conservons également cette information pour tenir compte des rôles futurs que vous pourriez postuler ou qui, selon nous, pourraient correspondre à vos antécédents et compétences.

Si nous n'avons plus besoin d'une entreprise légitime pour traiter vos informations, nous les supprimerons ou les anonymiserons. Si vous avez des questions sur la façon dont nous utilisons ou gérons vos informations, ou si vous souhaitez accéder, corriger ou supprimer vos données, veuillez contacter notre équipe de confidentialité à carriees@proton.ch.

Proton n'accepte pas les curriculum vitae non sollicités provenant d'autres sources que directement des candidats. Nous ne paierons pas de frais pour tout placement résultant d'une offre non sollicitée, même si le candidat est par la suite embauché par Proton.

Pour en savoir plus sur notre politique de confidentialité, veuillez visiter notre page de politique de confidentialité.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Join Proton and build a better internet where privacy is the default

At Proton, we believe that privacy is a fundamental human right and the cornerstone of democracy. Since our inception in 2014, founded by a team of scientists from CERN, we have dedicated ourselves to providing free and open-source technology to millions worldwide, ensuring access to privacy, security, and freedom online.

Our journey began with Proton Mail, the largest secure email service globally, and has since expanded to include Proton VPN, Proton Calendar, Proton Drive, and Proton Pass. These tools empower individuals and organizations to take control of their personal data, break away from Big Tech’s invasive practices, and defeat censorship. Our work impacts hundreds of millions of lives, from activists on the front lines defending freedom to leaders in governments protecting sensitive information. In some cases, Proton’s services have even been instrumental in saving lives by enabling secure and private communications in high-risk situations.

Proton is a profitable company that does not rely upon VC funding, supporting over 100 million user accounts with a growing team of over 500 people from over 50 different countries, from the world's top companies and universities. We value intelligence, learning potential, and ambition in our hiring process. Adaptability is key as we navigate uncharted territories and redefine how business is conducted online.

Hiring at Proton is highly selective, with less than 1% of candidates hired. We believe smaller teams of exceptional talent will always prevail over larger teams with lower talent density. You will have the opportunity to work with many of the world's top minds in their fields, ranging from former international math and science olympiad winners to chess champions.

We have a global mindset and big ambitions but remain a start-up at heart. We value empowerment and flexibility and keep our structure flat to keep moving fast and avoid unnecessary politics. Tired of blending into the crowd? Join us and do work you can truly be proud of. Check our open-source projects here!

The Team

As a Front-end Engineer at Standard Notes, you will play a crucial role in evolving our platform into the leading secure note-taking, knowledge management, and productivity solution. We are seeking a senior engineer who is passionate about client-side architecture, system design, and usability, and who thrives in a highly collaborative environment. You’ll work closely with Product, Design, API teams, and fellow engineers, driving data-informed decisions to deliver a seamless and secure user experience.

Current Projects:

The Standard Notes team is focused on building a comprehensive suite of tools to help users manage their knowledge and boost productivity while maintaining the highest standards of security and privacy. Recent efforts include advancing editor capabilities, improving data organization features, and optimizing cross-platform sync. You’ll work on architecting features such as encrypted search, tagging systems, advanced note formatting, and seamless integrations—all built with React and TypeScript and secured with end-to-end encryption.

Tech Stack and Tools:

• JavaScript, TypeScript, React, ES6, Playwright, Jest, Grafana
• All Standard Notes codebases are open source: https://github.com/standardnotes

Encryption presents unique challenges to front-end development. Features like search and syncing are designed to function entirely within a secure and encrypted environment, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in privacy-first software.

Future Plans:

As a team, we aim to continuously enhance the quality and performance of Standard Notes, transforming it into a feature-rich platform that caters to the diverse needs of both individuals and businesses. This includes improving knowledge management capabilities, expanding organizational tools, and creating integrations that enhance workflows—all while remaining committed to our core values of security, privacy, and simplicity.

What You Will Do:

• Develop, deploy, and support high-quality user experiences across our product portfolio, including features that enhance knowledge management, productivity, and data organization.
• Transform product specifications into technical requirements and lead your team to their successful implementation.
• Enhance Standard Notes’ development lifecycle, tools, and code structure for an improved developer experience through technical leadership and architecture.
• Write clear, concise, and testable code to maintain and elevate the quality of our codebase.
• Scope, plan, and execute new features, technical initiatives, and greenfield projects (depending on seniority).
• Foster a culture of learning, creativity, and accountability for the best possible work through mentorship and team development, role modeling quality assurance, and performance optimization.

Job • Requirements:

  • Deep understanding of JavaScript methodologies and design patterns
  • Proficiency with TypeScript or any typed language
  • Experience with React or 2+ similar frameworks, developing performant and reusable components
  • Strong understanding of software engineering best practices, such as SOLID, Design Patterns, CI/CD
  • A product mindset with a focus on offering the best user experiences
  • Experience working in a distributed team

Bonus points for:

  • Awareness of common security issues in client-side development, such as those in the OWASP top ten, and how to mitigate them
  • Familiarity with UX, accessibility, internationalization, and localization concerns and solutions
  • Experience with Grafana or other monitoring platforms
  • Experience with breaking down product requirements into architecture design and implementation
  • Experience with NodeJS
  • High-level understanding of cryptography concepts such as key exchange and the difference between symmetric and asymmetric encryption

What We Offer:

  • Office First: Collaboration is easier and more effective in person, which is why we have offices in Geneva, Zurich, Prague, Barcelona, Paris, London, Vilnius, Skopje, and Taipei. You can also enjoy working from home up to 30% of the time, while enjoying great company during our three core days in the office.
  • Technology: We provide all the devices and software you need to excel in your role, ensuring you have the best tools at your disposal to achieve your goals.
  • Food: Lunch and snacks are provided by Proton every day at our offices.
  • Transport: We will always support our employees with transport costs through subsidizing public transport, bike allowances, or parking spaces based on your office location.
  • Stock Options: At Proton, we are all owners of the company and you get stock options when you join us.
  • Flexible Working: You can define your own working hours as long as it works with team meetings.
  • Learning and Development: We are committed to your professional growth. Proton offers various learning opportunities, including training programs, conferences and events, and continual learning.
  • Employee Benefits: Comprehensive health insurance plans, competitive retirement savings options, generous vacation and leave policies, and wellness programs.
  • Work that Matters: Proton is a community-first organization, started with the support of a crowdfunding campaign and built with community input. To this day, Proton’s only source of revenue is user subscriptions. Over 100 million people trust and support Proton, and we put our users and community first in everything we do. Read more about our impact here.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At Proton, we believe diversity drives innovation and strengthens our mission to provide privacy as a default for all. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where all individuals, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, age, sexual orientation, physical ability, or socio-economic background, feel valued and empowered. We strive to create equal opportunities, promote open dialogue, and support continuous learning to ensure every voice is heard and respected.

If you need any extra support or reasonable adjustments during the hiring process, please let your talent partner know.

Candidate Privacy Notice

When you apply for a position, refer a candidate, or are considered for a role at Proton Technologies AG (Proton, we, us, or our), your information is stored in Greenhouse, in accordance with their Service Privacy Policy. This information is used to evaluate your suitability for the posted position. We also retain this information for consideration for future roles that you may apply for or that we believe may align with your background and skills.

If we no longer have a legitimate business need to process your information, we will either delete or anonymize it. Should you have any inquiries about how we use or manage your information, or if you wish to access, correct, or delete your data, please contact our privacy team at careers@proton.ch.

Proton does not accept unsolicited resumes from any sources other than directly from candidates. We will not pay a fee for any placement resulting from an unsolicited offer, even if the candidate is subsequently hired by Proton.

To learn more about our privacy policy, please visit our privacy policy page.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Join Proton and build a better internet where privacy is the default

At Proton, we believe that privacy is a fundamental human right and the cornerstone of democracy. Since our inception in 2014, founded by a team of scientists from CERN, we have dedicated ourselves to providing free and open-source technology to millions worldwide, ensuring access to privacy, security, and freedom online.

Our journey began with Proton Mail, the largest secure email service globally, and has since expanded to include Proton VPN, Proton Calendar, Proton Drive, and Proton Pass. These tools empower individuals and organizations to take control of their personal data, break away from Big Tech’s invasive practices, and defeat censorship. Our work impacts hundreds of millions of lives, from activists on the front lines defending freedom to leaders in governments protecting sensitive information. In some cases, Proton’s services have even been instrumental in saving lives by enabling secure and private communications in high-risk situations.

Proton is a profitable company that does not rely upon VC funding, supporting over 100 million user accounts with a growing team of over 500 people from over 50 different countries, from the world's top companies and universities. We value intelligence, learning potential, and ambition in our hiring process. Adaptability is key as we navigate uncharted territories and redefine how business is conducted online.

Hiring at Proton is highly selective, with less than 1% of candidates hired. We believe smaller teams of exceptional talent will always prevail over larger teams with lower talent density. You will have the opportunity to work with many of the world's top minds in their fields, ranging from former international math and science olympiad winners to chess champions.

We have a global mindset and big ambitions but remain a start-up at heart. We value empowerment and flexibility and keep our structure flat to keep moving fast and avoid unnecessary politics. Tired of blending into the crowd? Join us and do work you can truly be proud of. Check our open-source projects here!

The Team

As a Front-end Engineer at Standard Notes, you will play a crucial role in evolving our platform into the leading secure note-taking, knowledge management, and productivity solution. We are seeking a senior engineer who is passionate about client-side architecture, system design, and usability, and who thrives in a highly collaborative environment. You’ll work closely with Product, Design, API teams, and fellow engineers, driving data-informed decisions to deliver a seamless and secure user experience.

Current Projects:

The Standard Notes team is focused on building a comprehensive suite of tools to help users manage their knowledge and boost productivity while maintaining the highest standards of security and privacy. Recent efforts include advancing editor capabilities, improving data organization features, and optimizing cross-platform sync. You’ll work on architecting features such as encrypted search, tagging systems, advanced note formatting, and seamless integrations—all built with React and TypeScript and secured with end-to-end encryption.

Tech Stack and Tools:

• JavaScript, TypeScript, React, ES6, Playwright, Jest, Grafana
• All Standard Notes codebases are open source: https://github.com/standardnotes

Encryption presents unique challenges to front-end development. Features like search and syncing are designed to function entirely within a secure and encrypted environment, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in privacy-first software.

Future Plans:

As a team, we aim to continuously enhance the quality and performance of Standard Notes, transforming it into a feature-rich platform that caters to the diverse needs of both individuals and businesses. This includes improving knowledge management capabilities, expanding organizational tools, and creating integrations that enhance workflows—all while remaining committed to our core values of security, privacy, and simplicity.

What You Will Do:

• Develop, deploy, and support high-quality user experiences across our product portfolio, including features that enhance knowledge management, productivity, and data organization.
• Transform product specifications into technical requirements and lead your team to their successful implementation.
• Enhance Standard Notes’ development lifecycle, tools, and code structure for an improved developer experience through technical leadership and architecture.
• Write clear, concise, and testable code to maintain and elevate the quality of our codebase.
• Scope, plan, and execute new features, technical initiatives, and greenfield projects (depending on seniority).
• Foster a culture of learning, creativity, and accountability for the best possible work through mentorship and team development, role modeling quality assurance, and performance optimization.

Job • Requirements:

  • Deep understanding of JavaScript methodologies and design patterns
  • Proficiency with TypeScript or any typed language
  • Experience with React or 2+ similar frameworks, developing performant and reusable components
  • Strong understanding of software engineering best practices, such as SOLID, Design Patterns, CI/CD
  • A product mindset with a focus on offering the best user experiences
  • Experience working in a distributed team

Bonus points for:

  • Awareness of common security issues in client-side development, such as those in the OWASP top ten, and how to mitigate them
  • Familiarity with UX, accessibility, internationalization, and localization concerns and solutions
  • Experience with Grafana or other monitoring platforms
  • Experience with breaking down product requirements into architecture design and implementation
  • Experience with NodeJS
  • High-level understanding of cryptography concepts such as key exchange and the difference between symmetric and asymmetric encryption

What We Offer:

  • Office First: Collaboration is easier and more effective in person, which is why we have offices in Geneva, Zurich, Prague, Barcelona, Paris, London, Vilnius, Skopje, and Taipei. You can also enjoy working from home up to 30% of the time, while enjoying great company during our three core days in the office.
  • Technology: We provide all the devices and software you need to excel in your role, ensuring you have the best tools at your disposal to achieve your goals.
  • Food: Lunch and snacks are provided by Proton every day at our offices.
  • Transport: We will always support our employees with transport costs through subsidizing public transport, bike allowances, or parking spaces based on your office location.
  • Stock Options: At Proton, we are all owners of the company and you get stock options when you join us.
  • Flexible Working: You can define your own working hours as long as it works with team meetings.
  • Learning and Development: We are committed to your professional growth. Proton offers various learning opportunities, including training programs, conferences and events, and continual learning.
  • Employee Benefits: Comprehensive health insurance plans, competitive retirement savings options, generous vacation and leave policies, and wellness programs.
  • Work that Matters: Proton is a community-first organization, started with the support of a crowdfunding campaign and built with community input. To this day, Proton’s only source of revenue is user subscriptions. Over 100 million people trust and support Proton, and we put our users and community first in everything we do. Read more about our impact here.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At Proton, we believe diversity drives innovation and strengthens our mission to provide privacy as a default for all. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where all individuals, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, age, sexual orientation, physical ability, or socio-economic background, feel valued and empowered. We strive to create equal opportunities, promote open dialogue, and support continuous learning to ensure every voice is heard and respected.

If you need any extra support or reasonable adjustments during the hiring process, please let your talent partner know.

Candidate Privacy Notice

When you apply for a position, refer a candidate, or are considered for a role at Proton Technologies AG (Proton, we, us, or our), your information is stored in Greenhouse, in accordance with their Service Privacy Policy. This information is used to evaluate your suitability for the posted position. We also retain this information for consideration for future roles that you may apply for or that we believe may align with your background and skills.

If we no longer have a legitimate business need to process your information, we will either delete or anonymize it. Should you have any inquiries about how we use or manage your information, or if you wish to access, correct, or delete your data, please contact our privacy team at careers@proton.ch.

Proton does not accept unsolicited resumes from any sources other than directly from candidates. We will not pay a fee for any placement resulting from an unsolicited offer, even if the candidate is subsequently hired by Proton.

To learn more about our privacy policy, please visit our privacy policy page.
