descriptionByLocale.en:
At Endress+Hauser, progress happens by working together. As the global leader in measurement instrumentation, with over 18,000 employees shape the future in the field of process automation. Whether developing and realizing new technology as a team, collaborating to build instrumentation, or strengthening vital relationships with countless global industries, we work to create trusted relationships that help everyone thrive. As a family-owned company, we look beyond short-term moves and work to create a vision that is forward-thinking for our people, our clients, and the world at large.

We are looking for an Expert Global Production Master Data (f/m/d) to join our team and help lay the foundation for a connected, efficient, and future-ready global production environment where data makes the difference.

What is this position about?

Do you enjoy connecting complex production processes on a global scale? Are you excited about using data to make a real impact on quality, efficiency, and innovation? Do you find international coordination and cross-site collaboration motivating?

If so, you can expect an exciting role in which you will actively shape and further develop the digital backbone of our global production.

What tasks will you perform?

You will:

• work in a dynamic, globally operating team and collaborate across sites with production, engineering, and digitalization functions.

• coordinate complex alignments within an international production network.

• define, maintain, and ensure the quality of production master data, including variant configuration, and ensure consistent data structures throughout the entire product lifecycle.

• contribute to and optimize standards, processes, and continuous improvements in master data maintenance, driving global harmonization, standardization, and the further development of underlying process logic.

• take responsibility as a (sub-)project manager in product development projects for the global industrialization of new products and steer cross-site introduction and rollout activities within the international manufacturing network.

• ensure coordination and implementation of changes across the entire product lifecycle as a product-responsible manufacturing planner.

What do we expect from you?

You:

• hold a degree in a technical field (e.g., production engineering, mechanical engineering, industrial engineering, or similar) and have at least 8 years of professional experience in an industrial environment, with proven experience in production-related engineering, master data and industrialization roles, as well as international experience.

• bring strong expert knowledge in maintaining SAP production master data, particularly in routings, bills of materials, and variant configuration, along with a deep understanding of SAP ERP as a central system for managing and integrating core processes such as materials management, production planning, logistics, and master data.

• have proven experience in implementing, rolling out, or further developing SAP ME in a variant-rich manufacturing environment and are experienced in the operational implementation of complex system and process dependencies between the shop floor, SAP ME and SAP ERP.

• have at least 8 years of experience in project management and in the industrialization of new products, the introduction of new products, processes, or technologies, as well as cross-site rollouts in an international environment.

• possess a strong global mindset, intercultural competence, and the ability to effectively manage and coordinate complex topics in an international and decentralized production network. You can assess different requirements, priorities, processes, maturity levels, and local conditions of international production sites and translate them into sustainable, globally consistent, and implementable solutions.

• convince with a high level of communication, alignment, and integration skills across countries, functions, and locations, and have the ability to bring together diverse stakeholders with sometimes differing interests while sustainably harmonizing and optimizing global master data processes.

• are fluent in English, both written and spoken, and work in a structured, responsible and team-oriented manner.

What can you expect from us?

• We are a family-owned company with a strong commitment and a sustainable vision.

• We promote lifelong learning through diverse training and development opportunities, internal knowledge transfer, and e-learning.

• We support work-life balance with flexible working hours.

• We offer support for sustainable mobility solutions such as public transportation.

• We support family-friendly policies, including childcare places and childcare services during school holidays.

• We offer you a meaningful role with global impact in a stable and innovative working environment.

How do you apply?

To apply we kindly ask you to upload your documents on our career page. Applications sent to us by E-Mail can unfortunately not be considered due to Data Privacy Considerations.

Agencies, HR service providers, or similar entities are kindly requested to refrain from unsolicited submission of profiles and inquiries regarding potential collaboration. Currently, we do not engage with external service providers for this role. Any unsolicited applications will be disregarded and deleted without further consideration. We appreciate your understanding.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Service Contract Manager

__

The Global Spare Parts Forecasting Specialist serves as the central hub between ABB's Local Service Organizations (LSOs) across multiple countries and feeder factories supplying UPS spare parts. This role combines strategic demand forecasting with operational support for spare parts sales and service delivery. The primary focus is to ensure accurate demand signal capture, consolidation, and translation into actionable supply plans while supporting end-to-end spare parts management to achieve high-level service quality, operational efficiency, on-time delivery, order growth, and customer satisfaction.

The work model for the role is: hybrid #LI-hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Develop and maintain rolling demand forecasts for spare parts, consolidating inputs from LSOs and incorporating installed base data, failure rates, service contracts, product lifecycle changes, and new product introductions.
  • Collaborate with supply chain, engineering, product management, manufacturing, and service teams to ensure parts availability, manage supply risks, and support EOL, ECN, lead time, and inventory planning activities.
  • Monitor forecasting and supply performance through KPIs and dashboards, identify demand anomalies, and drive corrective actions to improve forecast accuracy, service levels, and on-time delivery.
  • Drive continuous improvement of planning processes, forecasting tools, ERP data quality, e-commerce platforms, and automation initiatives while ensuring compliance with ABB’s HSE and integrity standards.

• Qualifications for the role:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in spare parts planning, demand forecasting, service operations, or supply chain management.
  • Experience in power electronics, UPS, critical power systems, or industrial equipment is preferred.
  • Proficiency with ERP systems (e.g., SAP), forecasting tools, Excel/BI solutions, and e-commerce platforms.
  • Fluent English; additional European languages are an advantage.
  • Strong analytical and data-driven mindset with the ability to develop and improve forecasting models.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and cross-cultural communication skills, with the ability to translate complex inputs into actionable recommendations.
  • Solid knowledge of spare parts strategies, service operations, and process improvement, with a focus on service availability, delivery performance, standardization, and automation.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Bei ABB helfen wir Industrien, schlanker und sauberer zu laufen - und jeder Mensch hier macht das möglich. Sie werden in der Lage sein zu führen, unterstützt zu wachsen und stolz auf die Wirkung, die wir gemeinsam schaffen. Begleiten Sie uns und helfen Sie mit, was die Welt regiert.

Diese Position berichtet an:

Service Contract Manager

Der Global Spare Parts Forecasting Specialist dient als zentraler Knotenpunkt zwischen ABBs lokalen Serviceorganisationen (LSOs) in mehreren Ländern und Feeder Factorys, die USV-Ersatzteile liefern. Diese Rolle kombiniert strategische Nachfrageprognosen mit operativer Unterstützung für den Verkauf und die Servicelieferung von Ersatzteilen. Das Hauptaugenmerk liegt auf der Gewährleistung einer genauen Erfassung, Konsolidierung und Übersetzung von Bedarfssignalen in umsetzbare Versorgungspläne, während das End-to-End-Ersatzteilmanagement unterstützt wird, um eine hohe Servicequalität, Betriebseffizienz, pünktliche Lieferung, Auftragswachstum und Kundenzufriedenheit zu erreichen.

Das Arbeitsmodell für die Rolle ist: hybrid #LI-hybrid

Sie werden hauptsächlich verantwortlich sein für:

  • Entwicklung und Pflege von rollenden Bedarfsprognosen für Ersatzteile, Konsolidierung der Inputs von LSOs und Einbeziehung installierter Basisdaten, Ausfallraten, Serviceverträge, Produktlebenszyklusänderungen und Einführung neuer Produkte.
  • Arbeiten Sie mit Supply Chain-, Engineering-, Produktmanagement-, Fertigungs- und Serviceteams zusammen, um die Verfügbarkeit von Teilen sicherzustellen, Versorgungsrisiken zu managen und EOL-, ECN-, Vorlaufzeit- und Lagerplanungsaktivitäten zu unterstützen.
  • Überwachen Sie die Prognose- und Versorgungsleistung durch KPIs und Dashboards, identifizieren Sie Nachfrageanomalien und steuern Sie Korrekturmaßnahmen zur Verbesserung der Prognosegenauigkeit, des Serviceniveaus und der pünktlichen Lieferung an.
  • Steigende Verbesserung von Planungsprozessen, Prognosetools, ERP-Datenqualität, E-Commerce-Plattformen und Automatisierungsinitiativen bei gleichzeitiger Einhaltung der HSE- und Integritätsstandards von ABB.

• Qualifikationen für die Rolle:

  • Bachelor-Abschluss in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering oder einem verwandten Bereich.
  • 5+ Jahre Erfahrung in Ersatzteilplanung, Bedarfsprognose, Servicebetrieb oder Supply Chain Management.
  • Erfahrung in Leistungselektronik, USV, kritischen Stromversorgungssystemen oder Industriegeräten wird bevorzugt.
  • Kompetenz mit ERP-Systemen (z.B. SAP), Prognosetools, Excel/BI-Lösungen und E-Commerce-Plattformen.
  • Fluent English; zusätzliche europäische Sprachen sind von Vorteil.
  • Starke analytische und datengesteuerte Denkweise mit der Fähigkeit, Prognosemodelle zu entwickeln und zu verbessern.
  • Ausgezeichnetes Stakeholder-Management und interkulturelle Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Inputs in umsetzbare Empfehlungen zu übersetzen.
  • Fundiertes Wissen über Ersatzteilstrategien, Serviceoperationen und Prozessverbesserungen mit Schwerpunkt auf Serviceverfügbarkeit, Lieferleistung, Standardisierung und Automatisierung.

Der Aufbau einer saubereren, intelligenteren Zukunft erfordert alle Arten von Köpfen: das Neugierige, das Mutige und das Kreative. Deshalb begrüßen wir Menschen mit allen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen.

À ABB, nous aidons les industries à fonctionner de façon plus rationnelle et plus propre. Vous aurez le pouvoir de diriger, de soutenir pour grandir, et fier de l'impact que nous créons ensemble. Rejoignez-nous et aidez à exécuter ce qui dirige le monde.

Ce poste relève de :

Gestionnaire des contrats de services

Le spécialiste mondial de la prévision des pièces de rechange sert de centre central entre les organismes de services locaux (OSL) d'ABB dans plusieurs pays et les usines d'alimentation fournissant des pièces de rechange UPS. Ce rôle combine la prévision stratégique de la demande et le soutien opérationnel pour la vente de pièces de rechange et la prestation de services. L'objectif principal est d'assurer la saisie exacte du signal de demande, la consolidation et la traduction en plans d'approvisionnement réalisables tout en appuyant la gestion des pièces de rechange de bout en bout afin d'atteindre la qualité du service de haut niveau, l'efficacité opérationnelle, la livraison à temps, la croissance des commandes et la satisfaction de la clientèle.

Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est : hybride #LI-hybrid

Vous serez principalement responsable de :

  • Élaborer et tenir à jour des prévisions de la demande de pièces de rechange, regrouper les intrants des ASL et intégrer les données de base installées, les taux de défaillance, les contrats de service, les changements du cycle de vie des produits et les nouvelles introductions de produits. Les résultats de l'enquête sont les suivants: Collaborer avec les équipes de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, de l'ingénierie, de la gestion des produits, de la fabrication et des services afin d'assurer la disponibilité des pièces, de gérer les risques d'approvisionnement et d'appuyer les activités de planification des stocks, des délais et des délais de livraison. Surveiller le rendement des prévisions et de l'offre au moyen des ICR et des tableaux de bord, cerner les anomalies de la demande et prendre des mesures correctives pour améliorer l'exactitude des prévisions, les niveaux de service et la livraison à temps.
  • Favoriser l'amélioration continue des processus de planification, des outils de prévision, de la qualité des données du PGI, des plateformes de commerce électronique et des initiatives d'automatisation tout en assurant la conformité aux normes d'ESH et d'intégrité de l'ABB.

• Qualifications pour le rôle :

  • Baccalauréat en chaîne d'approvisionnement, affaires, génie, ou un domaine connexe.
  • 5+ ans d'expérience dans la planification des pièces de rechange, la prévision de la demande, les opérations de service ou la gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement.
  • L'expérience en électronique de puissance, en UPS, en systèmes d'alimentation critiques ou en équipement industriel est privilégiée.
  • Profiabilité avec les systèmes ERP (p. ex. SAP), les outils de prévision, les solutions Excel/BI et les plateformes de commerce électronique.
  • Fluent English; d'autres langues européennes sont un avantage.
  • Un état d'esprit analytique et fondé sur les données, capable de développer et d'améliorer les modèles de prévision.
  • Excellente gestion des intervenants et excellente communication interculturelle, avec la capacité de traduire des apports complexes en recommandations concrètes.
  • Connaissance approfondie des stratégies en matière de pièces de rechange, des opérations de service et de l'amélioration des processus, en mettant l'accent sur la disponibilité des services, la prestation des services, la normalisation et l'automatisation.

Construire un avenir plus propre et plus intelligent prend toutes sortes d'esprits : les curieux, les courageux et les créatifs. C'est pourquoi nous accueillons des gens de tous les horizons et de toutes les expériences.

Prêt à faire un impact?

Appliquer aujourd'hui ou visiter https://www.abb.com pour en savoir plus sur l'impact de nos solutions à travers le monde.

This position reports to:

IS Manager

__

In this role, you will have the opportunity to provide technical, business process and data advice to support ongoing operations and new software development. Each day, you will expand and utilize your knowledge on IS applications and emerging technologies. You will also showcase your expertise by overseeing the development, and validating the functionality, of the final IS application.

This role is contributing to all local divisions in Switzerland. Main stakeholders are business process owners, application owners and function managers across all organizational levels as well as local and global IS teams (architects, developers, IS security specialists, compliance specialists).

You will join a diverse and committed team where we support each other’s, and in which a self-reliant allrounder finds space to explore, grow, and excel.

The work model for the role is: hybrid #LI-hybrid (min. 60% on site)


You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Jointly with business stakeholders formulating user stories which document and "translate" business requirements into specifications for local or global development/support teams. Collaborating with these teams to ensure the use case and business user needs are understood.
  • Acting as a Subject Matter Expert in ongoing operations of IS applications, and participating in projects to introduce new or modify existing IS solutions/services, by contributing technology, business process and data expertise.
  • Supporting IS application power-users in resolving incidents and in further developing the functionality. Supporting them also in validating and user acceptance testing IS application solutions in stage environment. Formulating test scripts according to acceptance criteria.
  • Managing a specific IS application (for management of industrial standards), including budget responsibility. Providing efficient, requirement-compliant, and cost-effective provision and procurement of services for internal user groups.

• Qualifications for the Role:

  • Higher education degree in Computer Science or Business Informatics (University, University of Applied Sciences) or equivalent.
  • Fluent English and good German language skills (spoken and written).
  • Practical experience as an IS Functional Analyst or Business Analyst, preferably in an international environment. Experience as an IS Application Manager or IS Service Manager is advantageous.
  • Commitment to building trusted relationships to and consensus among various stakeholders. Ability to collaborate and communicate self-reliantly with all management levels.
  • Practical experience in requirements analysis and change management, as well as with the Software Development Lifecycle. Scrum or general Agile knowledge and Design Thinking knowledge are advantageous.
  • Talent and fondness for planning, organization, coordination, and communication.
  • Experience with or interest in industrial standards management or document management is an advantage.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

This position reports to:
Chapter Lead

__

As an R&D Engineer, you will leverage your technical expertise to validate and customize OEM single-phase and three-phase low-voltage Uninterruptible Power Supplies (UPS), ensuring they meet the requirements of mission-critical power protection applications and market specifications.

Reporting to R&D Hardware Chapter Lead, based in Quartino Switzerland, you will contribute significantly to initiatives related to ABB’s Uninterruptable Power Supplies (UPS) products

The work model for the role is: hybrid #LI-hybrid

Location: Quartino Switzerland

You will be mainly accountable for:

- Lead technical validation and customization of OEM 1ph and 3ph low voltage Uninterruptable Power Supplies (UPS), as well as batteries and accessories.

- Manage test partners (UL, Intertek, Dekra, Eurofins, etc.) to scope and plan test programs to demonstrate compliance with applicable IEC or UL standards.

- Manage the technical specifications of assigned products and support the Product Manager in developing the business case for product development.

- Drive root cause analysis and corrective actions related to issues found during qualification testing, as well as issues identified at customer sites.

- Maintain awareness of state-of-the-art technologies and collaborate with the research center in Switzerland and other ABB stakeholders to identify potential new UPS technologies.

• Qualifications for the Role:

- Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, along with more than two years of professional experience in electrical engineering.

- Experience working with power electronic systems is required.

- Experience in the use of various measuring equipment in a laboratory environment.

- Knowledge of product regulations and standards, including IEC and UL.

- Experience working with external laboratories and certification bodies.

- Knowledge of ECNs (Engineering Change Notifications), BOMs (Bills of Materials), and documentation systems.

- Experience with failure investigations and Root Cause Analysis (RCA).

- Knowledge of and experience with Agile methodology is an advantage.

- Fluent in English, both spoken and written.

More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Critical Power unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Regional Sales Manager Europe for Excitation & Hydropower

__

Job • Profile Summary

Implements the sales strategy and drives the respective sales process in Hydropower and industries in collaboration with the Local Division Sales Manager and the Business Line Sales Manager Europe. Generates sales opportunities and secures profitable sales for ABB’s Energy Industries Division and its Business Line Power Reliability in Switzerland. Builds long-term customer relationships and ensures immediate response to specific customer needs and issues.


Core • Responsibilities

  • Focuses on new greenfield projects, as well as on Installed Base (IB) and brownfield penetration and sells the entire solutions portfolio (across automation, excitation, protection, electrification, grid code compliance studies, and digital solutions) in collaboration with other ABB units.

  • Sells entire solutions portfolio to expand ABB’s footprint in Switzerland and acts as a marketer/salesperson of ABB’s products and solutions during marketing activities (campaigns, trade fairs, exhibitions, conferences, customer meetings).

  • Establishes long-term customer relationships by understanding their requirements and translates the needs of customer into relevant ABB offerings and solutions.

  • Understands the channel strategy and the establishment of related prices and prepares sales plan, reviews them, and proposes recovery plan(s) when needed.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Experience in business development, technical sales or bids and proposals, ideally within the power generation, automation, electrification, or industrial sectors.

  • Strong solution selling and value proposition creation abilities, cybersecurity and digital solutions acumen.

  • Strong understanding of project dynamics and Installed Base (IB) concepts and confidently promoting value‑adding solutions.

  • Skilled in identifying, developing, and securing sales opportunities based on customer needs and market trends.

  • Customer-focused mindset with strong communication and negotiation skills, building long‑term customer relationships and responding quickly and professionally to customer issues.

  • Willingness to travel as required (up to 50%).

  • Ability to fluently communicate in German and English; additional languages are an advantage (French).

Kurzprofil der Position

Setzt die Vertriebsstrategie um und steuert den entsprechenden Verkaufsprozess im Bereich Wasserkraft und Industrie in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem lokalen Divisionsvertriebsleiter sowie dem Business Line Sales Manager Europe. Generiert Verkaufschancen und erzielt profitable Verkaufsabschlüsse für die Division Energy Industries von ABB sowie deren Business Line Power Reliability in der Schweiz. Baut langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf und gewährleistet eine schnelle und professionelle Reaktion auf spezifische Kundenanforderungen und Anliegen.

Hauptaufgaben

  • Fokus auf neue Greenfield-Projekte sowie auf die Durchdringung der installierten Basis (Installed Base, IB) und von Brownfield-Projekten. Verkauf des gesamten Lösungsportfolios in Zusammenarbeit mit anderen ABB-Einheiten, darunter Automatisierungs-, Erregungs-, Schutz- und Elektrifizierungslösungen, Netzanschluss- und Grid-Code-Compliance-Studien sowie digitale Lösungen.

  • Vermarktung und Verkauf des gesamten Lösungsportfolios zur Erweiterung der ABB-Marktpräsenz in der Schweiz. Repräsentation von ABB-Produkten und -Lösungen bei Marketingaktivitäten wie Kampagnen, Messen, Ausstellungen, Konferenzen und Kundengesprächen.

  • Aufbau langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen durch das Verständnis der Kundenanforderungen und die Entwicklung passender ABB-Lösungen und Angebote.

  • Verständnis der Vertriebs- und Channel-Strategie sowie der entsprechenden Preisgestaltung. Erstellung und Überprüfung von Vertriebsplänen sowie Entwicklung von Gegenmaßnahmen und Aktionsplänen bei Bedarf.

Qualifikationen

  • Erfahrung in Business Development, technischem Vertrieb oder im Angebots- und Ausschreibungsmanagement, idealerweise in den Bereichen Energieerzeugung, Automatisierung, Elektrifizierung oder Industrie.

  • Ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten im Lösungsvertrieb und in der Entwicklung überzeugender Kundennutzenargumentationen sowie Kenntnisse im Bereich Cybersecurity und digitaler Lösungen.

  • Fundiertes Verständnis von Projektdynamiken und Installed-Base-Konzepten sowie die Fähigkeit, wertschöpfende Lösungen überzeugend zu positionieren.

  • Erfahrung in der Identifikation, Entwicklung und erfolgreichen Umsetzung von Vertriebschancen auf Basis von Kundenbedürfnissen und Markttrends.

  • Ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung sowie starke Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten mit Fokus auf den Aufbau langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen und eine schnelle, professionelle Bearbeitung von Kundenanliegen.

  • Reisebereitschaft von bis zu 50 %.

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse; weitere Sprachen, insbesondere Französisch, sind von Vorteil.

Résumé du poste

Met en œuvre la stratégie commerciale et pilote le processus de vente correspondant dans les secteurs de l’hydroélectricité et de l’industrie, en collaboration avec le Responsable commercial local de la division et le Business Line Sales Manager Europe. Génère des opportunités commerciales et assure des ventes rentables pour la division Energy Industries d’ABB et sa Business Line Power Reliability en Suisse. Développe des relations clients durables et garantit une réponse rapide aux besoins et problématiques spécifiques des clients.

Responsabilités principales

  • Se concentre sur les nouveaux projets Greenfield ainsi que sur le développement de la base installée (Installed Base, IB) et des projets Brownfield. Commercialise l’ensemble du portefeuille de solutions (automatisation, systèmes d’excitation, protection, électrification, études de conformité aux codes réseau et solutions numériques) en collaboration avec les autres unités d’ABB.

  • Vend l’ensemble du portefeuille de solutions afin de renforcer la présence d’ABB en Suisse et agit en tant qu’ambassadeur commercial des produits et solutions ABB lors d’activités marketing (campagnes, salons professionnels, expositions, conférences et rendez-vous clients).

  • Établit des relations clients à long terme en comprenant leurs exigences et en les traduisant en offres et solutions ABB pertinentes.

  • Comprend la stratégie de vente indirecte et la politique tarifaire associée. Prépare les plans de vente, les analyse et propose des plans d’actions correctifs lorsque cela est nécessaire.

• Qualifications requises

  • Expérience en développement commercial, vente technique ou gestion des offres et appels d’offres, idéalement dans les secteurs de la production d’énergie, de l’automatisation, de l’électrification ou de l’industrie.

  • Solides compétences en vente de solutions et en création de propositions de valeur, ainsi qu’une bonne compréhension des enjeux liés à la cybersécurité et aux solutions numériques.

  • Excellente compréhension des dynamiques de projet et des concepts liés à la base installée (IB), avec la capacité de promouvoir avec assurance des solutions à forte valeur ajoutée.

  • Aptitude à identifier, développer et concrétiser des opportunités commerciales sur la base des besoins des clients et des tendances du marché.

  • Forte orientation client, excellentes compétences en communication et en négociation, avec une capacité à construire des relations durables et à répondre rapidement et professionnellement aux demandes des clients.

  • Disponibilité pour des déplacements professionnels pouvant atteindre 50 % du temps.

  • Maîtrise courante de l’allemand et de l’anglais ; la connaissance d’autres langues, notamment le français, constitue un atout.

More about us

ABB’s Energy Industries Division is enabling safe, smart, and sustainable projects and operations for businesses across the oil, gas, chemicals, life sciences, power generation, and water sectors. Driving integrated solutions that automate, digitalize, and electrify operations across industries. The division strives to connect our people and technology capabilities, along with our robust global execution capacity and widespread service footprint to help customers adapt and succeed. With over 50 years of domain expertise, we continue to innovate and reshape traditional approaches across the energy sector with our technologies, that are designed to improve operational efficiency, reduce risk, decrease energy consumption and waste.

Our Benefits

  • Attractive compensation including bonus, 13th-month salary, and participation programs (ESAP).

  • Career development through targeted training and development opportunities.

  • REKA checks for leisure and travel.

  • Company holidays between Christmas and New Year.

  • Various discounts on sports equipment, electronics, and health & wellness offers.

  • Contribution toward gym membership.

The recruitment process is led by Talent Partner Gema de Vicente.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

- Guidare le attività di reporting e gestione delle esenzioni normative a livello globale, compresi EMIR, EMIR UK, Dodd-Frank e altri requisiti applicabili.

- Sostenere progetti del Tesoro, implementazioni del sistema, attività di testing e iniziative di trasformazione dei processi con esperienza operativa approfondita.

Il tuo background

- Laurea magistrale in Finanza, Contabilità, Economia, Amministrazione aziendale, o un campo correlato.

- Esperienza significativa in Tesoro, Finanza o funzioni correlate all'interno di una multinazionale o di un istituto finanziario.

- Conoscenza degli obblighi di regolamentazione globale, compresi EMIR, EMIR del Regno Unito, Dodd-Frank e relativi quadri.

- esperienza nella gestione dei controlli, dei processi di qualità dei dati, dei rischi operativi e gestione delle eccezioni.

- esperienza di supporto alle implementazioni del sistema, testing, gestione dei cambiamenti e iniziative di miglioramento dei processi.

- Forte attenzione all'eccellenza operativa, con grande attenzione ai dettagli e alla capacità di gestire le attività ricorrenti, le priorità concorrenti e i risultati sensibili al tempo.

- Elevata integrità, forte responsabilità e giudizio professionale ben sviluppato.

Questa è l'occasione per svolgere un ruolo centrale nel rafforzamento e nell'ammodernamento delle capacità del Ministero del Tesoro all'interno di un'organizzazione globale. Se la governance, i controlli, i sistemi, i dati e il miglioramento continuo vi ispirano, e vi piace combinare proprietà funzionale con collaborazione cross-funzionale, accogliamo con favore la vostra applicazione.

At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:
Head Treasury Performance and Risk Analytics

__

Join our Corporate Treasury team and play a key role in ensuring effective operations, governance, and continuous improvement of Treasury Middle Office activities. In this role, you will oversee critical Treasury processes, support Treasury Management System (TMS) operations, and help maintain a robust control environment across Treasury systems, data, and regulatory reporting.

You will collaborate with Treasury, Accounting, Technology, Internal Control, and external partners to promote operational excellence, enhance controls, improve data quality, and support key Treasury initiatives and system upgrades.

Your Role &
• Responsibilities

-
End-to-end ownership of key global Treasury Middle Office processes, ensuring robust governance, controls, documentation, and operational effectiveness.

-
Serve as the principal Middle Office subject-matter expert for Treasury Management System (TMS) operations, system functionality, process improvement, and business requirements.

-
Provide senior functional oversight of system configurations and reference data, including financial instruments, portfolios, market data, limits, and valuation settings.

-
Govern system and data changes through controlled, documented, and auditable processes.

-
Lead root-cause analysis and resolution of complex operational, system, data, and accounting-related issues across multiple stakeholder groups.

-
Own and enhance Treasury controls, including reconciliations, data quality monitoring, exception management, and limit oversight.

-
Own the Global Market Data process, ensuring data completeness and accuracy, integrity, and continuous improvement.

-
Lead the global regulatory reporting and exemption management activities, including EMIR, UK EMIR, Dodd-Frank, and other applicable requirements.

-
Manage the global Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) lifecycle and related master data processes.

-
Support Treasury projects, system implementations, testing activities, and process transformation initiatives with in-depth operational experience.

Your Background

-
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.

-
Significant experience in Treasury, Finance, or related functions within a multinational corporation or financial institution.

-
Strong understanding of Treasury operations, transaction lifecycles, Treasury Management Systems, controls, reconciliations and market data.

-
Knowledge of global regulatory reporting requirements, including EMIR, UK EMIR, Dodd-Frank, and related frameworks.

-
Experience managing controls, data quality processes, operational risk issues, and exception handling.

-
Experience supporting system implementations, testing, change management, and process improvement initiatives.

-
Strong focus on operational excellence, with high attention to detail and the ability to manage recurring activities, competing priorities, and time-sensitive deliverables.

-
High integrity, strong accountability, and well-developed professional judgment.

This is an opportunity to play a central role in strengthening and modernizing Treasury Middle Office capabilities within a global organization. If Treasury governance, controls, systems, data, and continuous improvement inspire you, and you enjoy combining functional ownership with cross-functional collaboration, we welcome your application.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:
Field Service Engineer

Your role and responsibilities

A s a Service Engineer, you will execute service work on rolling stock and energy storing systems with low to medium complexity according to work instructions and in accordance with ABB standard processes, quality standards and safety guidelines. You will be in close cooperation with customers and other ABB teams, acting as the technical point while delivering quality and satisfying customer service.

Reporting to the Head of Field Service, you will be responsible for providing routine maintenance and on-site or remote technical support. The position involves approximately 50 days of domestic and 30 days of international travel, as you will be providing hands-on assistance at customer sites.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

The main responsibilities include

- Performing service tasks like installation and commissioning of equipment, identifying technical problems, making analysis through remote or on-site activity in different service categories (installation and commissioning, routine maintenance, extensions, replacements etc.)

- Consulting with and advising customers on the best service solutions in accordance with standard processes, procedures, and safety guidelines. Furthermore c reating and maintaining strong relationships with customers, appreciating their needs, and providing specialist assistance and solutions

- Coordinating and executing specialist projects through planning, meeting milestones and regular reviews

- Troubleshooting simple equipment failure and making recommendations to avoid repeating the problem in the future. Identifying opportunities to develop new service applications, equipment and methods

• Qualifications for the role

- Four years of experience in electrical work, testing, maintenance, or service, working as test- or commissioning engineer with power electronics or on electrical vehicles

- K nowledge and hands-on experience in servicing, maintaining , commissioning and repairing of power electronic products

- Ability to travel worldwide

- Proven leadership skills, with a collaborative, solution-focused approach and strong written and spoken communication skills

- A technician or engineer bachelor’s degree in electrotechnics

- Required language skills are fluent German , French, and English

More about us

ABB Traction Division is a recognized leader in onboard propulsion technologies that drive innovation in rail, bus, and industrial vehicle electrification. A comprehensive range of high-performance and full lifecycle managed propulsion, auxiliary and energy storage solutions help improve energy efficiency and contribute to making transportation more sustainable. We all together make the difference for our customers every day. We look forward to receiving your application.

Service Operations Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

As a Field Service Engineer, you are a key player in our organization and one of our primary ambassadors to our customers. The value of our solutions is also reflected in the quality of their implementation in the field. Whether it involves commissioning, maintenance, or troubleshooting, our specialists are recognized and valued for their technical expertise, professionalism, and interpersonal skills.

  • Federal Certificate of Proficiency (CFC) in Automation, Automation Assembly, Electronics, Electrical Installation, Electrical Assembly, or equivalent qualification.

  • Experience in the field of power electronics is desired.

  • Excellent command of French; good communication skills in English are required. Knowledge of German is an advantage.

  • Good knowledge of Microsoft Office tools.

  • Availability for a field-based role with frequent travel across Switzerland and on-call duty.

  • Good communication skills.

  • Self-reliant, responsible, and customer-oriented personality.

Benefits

We also offer our employees the following benefits:

  • Employee share acquisition plan (ESAP)

  • REKA credit

  • Employee discounts (MyDiscounts / Swibeco)

  • Parental leave

  • Fitness allowance

ABB Motion provides pioneering technology, products, solutions and related services to industrial customers to increase energy efficiency, improve safety and reliability, and maintain precise control over processes. At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Fulfillment Lead

__

Your role and responsibilities
Join ABB and become a vital part of our supply chain, ensuring the seamless flow of materials from our global suppliers to our production lines. In this critical role, you will be the central point of contact for purchasing and fulfillment, where your planning and problem-solving skills will directly impact our ability to deliver high-quality products to our customers on time, every time.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

You will be mainly responsible for

  • End-to-End Order Management: Manage the entire purchasing lifecycle within SAP, from creating and releasing purchase orders to actively monitoring and expediting them to align with production schedules and customer delivery deadlines.

  • Supplier Performance & Partnership: Drive supplier excellence by monitoring key performance indicators such as on-time delivery, quality, and lead times. You will conduct performance reviews and proactively resolve issues to strengthen our supply chain partnerships.

  • Logistics Coordination & Problem Solving: Oversee the inbound logistics process, including freight and customs clearance. You will be the go-to expert for handling urgent delivery situations and managing non-conformance reports to ensure operational continuity.

  • Data Analysis & Process Improvement: Proactively identify opportunities to improve our fulfillment process by analyzing order backlogs, identifying root causes for delays, and implementing effective recovery plans. You will monitor and ensure the integrity of data exchanged through supplier EDI systems.

• Qualifications for the role

  • A degree or diploma in a technical field, Process Management, or Supply Chain Management.

  • Proven experience in a similar role within a manufacturing or industrial environment.

  • Strong, hands-on knowledge of SAP is essential for this role.

  • Excellent communication skills with fluency in both English and Italian.

  • A proactive and solution-oriented mindset, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic setting.

  • Experience with order handling, inventory management, and data analysis would be a significant advantage.

More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

The recruitment process is led by Pedro Labian Sanchez, Talent Acquisition Partner at ABB Switzerland.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Fulfillment Lead

Ihre Rolle und Verantwortung
Steigen Sie sich ABB an und werden Sie ein wichtiger Teil unserer Lieferkette, um den nahtlosen Materialfluss von unseren globalen Lieferanten zu unseren Produktionslinien zu gewährleisten. In dieser kritischen Rolle sind Sie der zentrale Ansprechpartner für Einkauf und Fulfillment, wo Ihre Planungs- und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten sich direkt auf unsere Fähigkeit auswirken, unseren Kunden jederzeit und pünktlich hochwertige Produkte zu liefern.

Das Arbeitsmodell für die Rolle ist: #LI-Hybrid

Sie sind hauptsächlich verantwortlich für

  • End-to-End Order Management: Verwalten Sie den gesamten Einkaufslebenszyklus innerhalb von SAP, von der Erstellung und Freigabe von Bestellungen bis hin zur aktiven Überwachung und Beschleunigung, um sie an die Produktionspläne und Lieferfristen der Kunden anzupassen.

  • Supplier Performance & Partnership: Steigern Sie die Exzellenz der Lieferanten, indem Sie wichtige Leistungsindikatoren wie pünktliche Lieferung, Qualität und Durchlaufzeiten überwachen. Sie führen Leistungsüberprüfungen durch und lösen proaktiv Probleme, um unsere Lieferkettenpartnerschaften zu stärken.

  • Logistikkoordination & Problemlösung: Beaufsichtigen Sie den Inbound-Logistikprozess, einschließlich der Fracht- und Zollabfertigung. Sie sind der Ansprechpartner für dringende Liefersituationen und die Verwaltung von Nichtkonformitätsberichten, um die operative Kontinuität zu gewährleisten.

  • Datenanalyse & Prozessverbesserung: Erkennen Sie proaktiv Möglichkeiten zur Verbesserung unseres Fulfillment-Prozesses, indem Sie Auftragsrückstände analysieren, Ursachen für Verzögerungen identifizieren und effektive Wiederherstellungspläne implementieren. Sie überwachen und gewährleisten die Integrität der Daten, die über EDI-Systeme von Lieferanten ausgetauscht werden.

• Qualifikationen für die Rolle

  • Ein Abschluss oder Diplom in einem technischen Bereich, Prozessmanagement oder Supply Chain Management.

  • Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in einer ähnlichen Rolle in einer Fertigungs- oder Industrieumgebung.

  • Starke, praktische Kenntnisse von SAP sind für diese Rolle unerlässlich.

  • Exzellente Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit fließender Englisch- und Italienischkenntnissen.

  • Eine proaktive und lösungsorientierte Denkweise mit der Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten in einem dynamischen Umfeld zu verwalten.

Die technischen Teams der Division arbeiten eng mit Industriepartnern zusammen und liefern fortschrittliche Lösungen, die schnelles Wachstum, Energiewende und Nachhaltigkeitsziele unterstützen. Das Portfolio der Division umfasst industrielle Leistungsschalter, Niederspannungssysteme, Motorstartanwendungen und Sicherheitsgeräte wie Schalter und Relais. Seine Power Protection-Einheit unterstützt die weltweit größten Rechenzentrumsunternehmen mit fortschrittlichen energieeffizienten USV-Lösungen. This position reports to:

Global Project Operations Manager

__

Take your next career step at ABB with a team that is energizing the transformation of society and industry to achieve a more productive, sustainable future.

In this role, you will lead a team of eight Project Managers and oversee a diverse portfolio of customer projects within ABB's Motion Traction division in Turgi, Switzerland. You will drive project execution and operational excellence by setting clear priorities, providing guidance and mentorship, fostering collaboration, and ensuring the successful delivery of projects in line with quality, schedule, and financial objectives.

The work model is hybrid.

• Your responsibilities:

  • Lead and develop the Project Management team, setting performance expectations, coaching and mentoring team members, fostering engagement, and promoting a culture aligned with ABB's values and people-focused strategies.

  • Ensure successful delivery of customer projects, driving on-time, high-quality, and cost-effective execution while supporting bid activities, managing risks, and maintaining strong customer focus and stakeholder collaboration.

  • Drive project management excellence and continuous improvement, establishing effective methodologies, processes, governance frameworks, and best practices to strengthen project execution capabilities across the organization.

  • Monitor business performance and resource effectiveness, overseeing KPIs, portfolio performance, operational improvements, and cross-functional collaboration with supply chain and other stakeholders to achieve contractual, quality, and financial objectives.

• Your profile:

  • Bachelor's or master’s degree in electrical engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.

  • 5-10 years of experience managing complex projects, including scope, budget, schedule, and supplier/subcontractor performance.

  • Previous experience leading a team of Project Managers is highly desirable.

  • Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and collaboration skills, with a proactive and solution-oriented mindset.

  • Fluency in German and English is required; additional language skills are considered an asset.

More about us

ABB Motion, a global leader in motors and drives, is at the core of accelerating a more productive and sustainable future. We innovate and push the boundaries of technology to contribute to energy efficient, decarbonizing and circular solutions for customers, industries and societies. With our digitally enabled drives, motors and services we support our customers and partners to achieve better performance, safety and reliability. To help the world’s industries outrun – leaner and cleaner, we deliver motor-driven solutions for a wide range of applications in all industrial segments. Building on over 140 years of domain expertise in electric powertrains, our more than 22,000 employees across 100 countries learn and improve every day. go.abb/motion

Questa posizione è riportata a: Performance e analisi dei rischi del Tesoro

E' un'idea divertente.

Unisciti al team di Treasury Performance and Risk Analytics e gioca un ruolo chiave nel supporto all'analisi quantitativa, alla trasparenza dei rischi e alla rendicontazione della gestione attraverso il Treasury. In qualità di manager responsabile delle performance e dell'analisi dei rischi, combinerai profonde conoscenze in materia di rischio finanziario, metodologie quantitative, dati e reporting per supportare processi decisionali informati e migliorare gli strumenti analitici del Treasury.

Lavorando a stretto contatto con i team di Treasury, Technology e Data Engineering, svilupperete soluzioni analitiche scalabili, migliorerete le metodologie di rischio e garantirete una governance robusta, controlli e standard di reporting nelle attività del Treasury.

Il tuo ruolo e le tue responsabilità

- Gestire la progettazione, l'implementazione e il miglioramento continuo di analisi delle esposizioni del Tesoro, metodologie di rischio, approcci di valutazione e quadri di misurazione delle performance in FX, tasso di interesse, liquidità e rischio di credito di controparte.

- Sviluppare e mantenere metriche di rischio, analisi di scenari, misure di sensibilità e quadri di test di stress, garantendo una solida progettazione e validazione di metodologie.

- Fornire reporting di gestione basato su analisi, informazioni sulle prestazioni del Tesoro e raccomandazioni per sostenere il processo decisionale degli stakeholder senior.

- Definire requisiti analitici, logica di calcolo e standard qualitativi, collaborando strettamente con il Tesoriere Data Engineer per sviluppare soluzioni di scalabilità all'interno della Banca dati Treasury (TRDB).

- Convalidare dati e uscite di sistema per garantire completezza, accuratezza, tracciabilità e disponibilità all'analisi quantitativa.

- Sviluppare e migliorare reporting, dashboard e flussi di lavoro analitici automatizzati utilizzando strumenti come Power BI, Python, R e VBA.

- Garantire che le metodologie, i processi di rendicontazione e i controlli del Tesoro rispettino i requisiti normativi, le politiche interne e gli standard di audit.

- Mantenere una chiara documentazione di metodologie, modelli, controlli e processi di reporting a sostegno della governance e delle revisioni normative.

Il tuo background

- Laurea magistrale in Finanza, Econometria, Gestione del Rischio Finanziario, Matematica, Statistica, Ingegneria, o una disciplina quantitativa o finanziaria correlata.

- Esperienza significativa in Tesoro, Gestione del Rischio Finanziario, Analisi quantitativa, o un contesto di mercati finanziari comparabili.

- Esperienza dimostrata con analisi quantitative, modellizzazione finanziaria, approcci di valutazione, test di stress e metriche di performance.

- Abilità avanzate di programmazione e analisi, compresa l'esperienza con Power BI, Python, R, VBA o strumenti comparabili.

- Esperienza lavorando con i Sistemi di Gestione del Tesoro, le piattaforme di dati di mercato e gli ambienti di reporting analitico.

- Una solida comprensione dei principi contabili e degli obblighi di informativa finanziaria pertinenti alle attività del Tesoro, compresi i Principi contabili statunitensi.

At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:
Head Treasury Performance and Risk Analytics

__

Join the Treasury Performance and Risk Analytics team and play a key role in supporting quantitative analytics, risk transparency, and management reporting across Treasury. As the manager responsible for performance and risk analytics, you will combine deep knowledge in financial risk, quantitative methodologies, data, and reporting to support informed decision-making and improve Treasury's analytical tools.

Working closely with Treasury, Technology, and Data Engineering teams, you will develop scalable analytical solutions, enhance risk methodologies, and ensure robust governance, controls, and reporting standards across Treasury activities.

Your Role &
• Responsibilities

-
Manage the design, implementation, and continuous enhancement of Treasury exposure analytics, risk methodologies, valuation approaches, and performance measurement frameworks across FX, interest rate, liquidity, and counterparty credit risk.

-
Develop and maintain risk metrics, scenario analyses, sensitivity measures, and stress-testing frameworks, ensuring robust methodology design and validation.

-
Deliver analytics-driven management reporting, Treasury performance insights, and recommendations to support senior stakeholder decision-making.

-
Define analytical data requirements, calculation logic, and quality standards, collaborating closely with the Treasury Data Engineer to develop scalable solutions within the Treasury Database (TRDB).

-
Validate data and system outputs to ensure completeness, accuracy, traceability, and readiness for quantitative analysis.

-
Develop and enhance reporting, dashboards, and automated analytical workflows using tools such as Power BI, Python, R, and VBA.

-
Ensure Treasury methodologies, reporting processes, and controls comply with regulatory requirements, internal policies, and audit standards.

-
Maintain clear documentation of methodologies, models, controls, and reporting processes to support governance and regulatory reviews.

Your Background

-
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Econometrics, Financial Risk Management, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or a related quantitative or financial discipline.

-
Significant experience in Treasury, Financial Risk Management, Quantitative Analytics, or a comparable financial markets environment.

-
Deep understanding of FX, interest rate, liquidity, and counterparty credit risk, including their impact on valuation, financial results, balance sheet, cash flows, and Treasury performance.

-
Demonstrated experience with quantitative analysis, financial modeling, valuation approaches, stress testing, and performance metrics.

-
Advanced programming and analytics skills, including experience with Power BI, Python, R, VBA, or comparable tools.

-
Experience working with Treasury Management Systems, market data platforms, and analytical reporting environments.

-
Solid understanding of accounting principles and financial reporting requirements relevant to Treasury activities, including US GAAP.

-
Highly developed problem-solving, stakeholder collaboration, and decision-making skills, with a consistent focus on quality, controls, and ongoing improvement.

-
High level of integrity, professional judgment, and attention to detail.

This is a unique opportunity to shape Treasury performance and risk analytics at a strategic level, supporting data-driven decision-making across a global organization. If you are interested in applying financial risk skills alongside advanced analytics and reporting, we invite you to apply.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Bei ABB helfen wir Industrien, schlanker und sauberer zu sein – und das macht jeder Mensch hier. Sie werden dazu befähigt, zu führen, zu wachsen und stolz auf die Wirkung, die wir gemeinsam erzeugen.

Diese Position berichtet an: Head Treasury Performance and Risk Analytics

Begleiten Sie das Treasury Performance and Risk Analytics Team und spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Unterstützung von quantitativen Analysen, Risikotransparenz und Managementberichterstattung im gesamten Treasury. Als Manager für Performance und Risk Analytics werden Sie tiefe Kenntnisse in finanziellen Risiken, quantitativen Methoden, Daten und Berichterstattung kombinieren, um fundierte Entscheidungen zu unterstützen und die Analyseinstrumente des Treasury zu verbessern.

In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Treasury, Technology und Data Engineering Teams entwickeln Sie skalierbare Analyselösungen, verbessern Risikomethoden und gewährleisten eine robuste Governance, Kontrolle und Berichterstattung über alle Treasury-Aktivitäten hinweg.

Ihre Rolle &
• Verantwortung

- Verwalten Sie die Konzeption, Implementierung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Treasury-Expositionsanalyse, Risikomethoden, Bewertungsansätze und Leistungsmessungsrahmen für FX, Zinssatz, Liquidität und Gegenparteikreditrisiko.

- Entwicklung und Aufrechterhaltung von Risikometriken, Szenarioanalysen, Sensitivitätsmaß nahmen und Stresstestrahmen, um eine robuste Methodikgestaltung und Validierung zu gewährleisten.

- Bereitstellung von Analyse-gesteuerte Management-Reporting, Treasury Performance-Insights und Empfehlungen, um Senior Stakeholder Entscheidungsfindung zu unterstützen.

- Definieren Sie analytische Datenanforderungen, Berechnungslogik und Qualitätsstandards und entwickeln Sie gemeinsam mit dem Treasury Data Engineer skalierbare Lösungen innerhalb der Treasury Database (TRDB).

- Validierung von Daten und Systemausgängen, um Vollständigkeit, Genauigkeit, Rückverfolgbarkeit und Bereitschaft zur quantitativen Analyse zu gewährleisten.

- Entwicklung und Verbesserung von Reporting, Dashboards und automatisierten analytischen Workflows mit Tools wie Power BI, Python, R und VBA.

- Gewährleistung der Einhaltung der Finanzmethodik, der Berichterstattungsprozesse und der Kontrollen mit den regulatorischen Anforderungen, internen Richtlinien und Prüfungsstandards.

- Aufrechterhaltung einer klaren Dokumentation von Methoden, Modellen, Kontrollen und Berichterstattungsprozessen zur Unterstützung von Governance und regulatorischen Überprüfungen.

Ihr Hintergrund

- Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Finanzen, Ökonometrie, Financial Risk Management, Mathematik, Statistik, Ingenieurwesen oder einer damit verbundenen quantitativen oder finanziellen Disziplin.

- Bedeutende Erfahrung in den Bereichen Treasury, Financial Risk Management, Quantitative Analytics oder einem vergleichbaren Finanzmarktumfeld.

- Vertiefung des FX-, Zins-, Liquiditäts- und Gegenparteikreditrisikos, einschließlich ihrer Auswirkungen auf die Bewertung, die Finanzergebnisse, die Bilanz, die Cashflows und die Treasury-Performance.

- Vorgestellte Erfahrung mit quantitativen Analysen, Finanzmodellierung, Bewertungsansätzen, Stresstests und Leistungskennzahlen.

- Erweiterte Programmier- und Analysefähigkeiten, einschließlich Erfahrung mit Power BI, Python, R, VBA oder vergleichbaren Tools.

- Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Treasury Management Systemen, Marktdatenplattformen und analytischen Berichterstattungsumgebungen.

- solides Verständnis der Rechnungslegungsgrundsätze und der für die Treasury-Aktivitäten relevanten Rechnungslegungsanforderungen, einschließlich US-GAAP.

- Hochentwickelte Problemlösung, Stakeholder-Zusammenarbeit und Entscheidungskompetenzen mit einem konsequenten Fokus auf Qualität, Kontrolle und laufende Verbesserung.

- Hohe Integrität, professionelles Urteilsvermögen und Liebe zum Detail.

Dies ist eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, die Treasury Performance und Risikoanalyse auf strategischer Ebene zu gestalten und die datengestützte Entscheidungsfindung in einer globalen Organisation zu unterstützen. Wenn Sie neben der fortgeschrittenen Analyse und Berichterstattung finanzielle Risikokompetenzen anwenden möchten, laden wir Sie ein, sich zu bewerben.

Ce poste relève de : Dirigeant de la performance de la trésorerie et de l'analyse des risques

__

En tant que gestionnaire responsable de l'analyse du rendement et du risque, vous combinerez des connaissances approfondies sur les risques financiers, les méthodologies quantitatives, les données et les rapports pour appuyer la prise de décisions éclairées et améliorer les outils analytiques du Trésor.

En étroite collaboration avec les équipes de la Trésorerie, de la Technologie et du Génie des données, vous développerez des solutions analytiques évolutives, améliorerez les méthodes de gestion des risques et assurerez une gouvernance solide, des contrôles et des normes de déclaration dans l'ensemble des activités de la Trésorerie.

Votre rôle &
• Responsabilités

- Gérer la conception, la mise en œuvre et l'amélioration continue de l'analyse de l'exposition de la trésorerie, des méthodes de gestion des risques, des méthodes d'évaluation et des cadres de mesure des résultats pour les FX, les taux d'intérêt, les liquidités et les risques de crédit des contreparties.

- Élaborer et maintenir des mesures du risque, des analyses de scénarios, des mesures de sensibilité et des cadres de test de stress, en veillant à la conception et à la validation de méthodes robustes.

- Fournir des rapports de gestion axés sur l'analyse, des renseignements sur le rendement de la Trésorerie et des recommandations pour appuyer la prise de décisions par les intervenants supérieurs.

- Définir les exigences en matière de données analytiques, la logique de calcul et les normes de qualité, en collaboration étroite avec l'ingénieur des données de trésorerie pour développer des solutions évolutives dans la base de données de trésorerie (TRDB).

- Valider les données et les sorties du système pour assurer l'exhaustivité, l'exactitude, la traçabilité et la préparation à l'analyse quantitative.

- Élaborer et améliorer les rapports, les tableaux de bord et les processus d'analyse automatisés en utilisant des outils tels que Power BI, Python, R et VBA.

- Veiller à ce que les méthodes, les processus de déclaration et les contrôles de la Trésorerie soient conformes aux exigences réglementaires, aux politiques internes et aux normes de vérification.

- Maintenir une documentation claire des méthodes, des modèles, des contrôles et des processus de rapport pour appuyer la gouvernance et les examens réglementaires.

Vos antécédents

- Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en finance, économétrie, gestion des risques financiers, mathématiques, statistiques, génie ou une discipline quantitative ou financière connexe.

- Expérience significative en trésorerie, gestion des risques financiers, analyse quantitative ou environnement comparable des marchés financiers.

- Une compréhension approfondie des risques de crédit FX, taux d'intérêt, liquidité et contrepartie, y compris leur incidence sur l'évaluation, les résultats financiers, le bilan, les flux de trésorerie et les performances du Trésor.

- Expérience démontrée en analyse quantitative, modélisation financière, méthodes d'évaluation, essais de stress et mesures de performance.

- Compétences avancées en programmation et en analyse, y compris expérience avec Power BI, Python, R, VBA ou des outils comparables.

- Expérience de travail avec les systèmes de gestion de la trésorerie, les plateformes de données de marché et les environnements d'analyse.

- Une bonne compréhension des principes comptables et des exigences en matière d'information financière applicables aux activités du Trésor, y compris les PCGR des États-Unis.

- La résolution de problèmes, la collaboration avec les intervenants et les compétences décisionnelles, en mettant l'accent sur la qualité, les contrôles et l'amélioration continue.

- Haute intégrité, jugement professionnel et attention aux détails.

C'est une occasion unique de façonner la performance du Trésor et l'analyse des risques au niveau stratégique, en appuyant la prise de décisions axées sur les données dans une organisation mondiale. Si vous êtes intéressé à appliquer les compétences en risque financier aux côtés de l'analyse et de la déclaration avancées, nous vous invitons à postuler.

Construire un avenir plus propre et plus intelligent prend toutes sortes d'esprits : les curieux, les courageux et les créatifs. C'est pourquoi nous accueillons des gens de tous horizons et expériences.

Faites votre demande aujourd'hui ou visitez https://www.abb.com pour en savoir plus sur l'impact de nos solutions dans le monde entier.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Global Procurement Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

The Global Procurement Specialist / Global Category Specialist for Power Electronics Components is a senior individual contributor responsible for developing and executing global category strategies for key power semiconductor and passive components used across ABB's power electronics product lines. The role requires deep technical knowledge of power electronics BOMs, strong commercial acumen, and the ability to manage complex, multi-site supplier relationships globally.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

Your main accountabilities will be to:
  • Define and execute global category sourcing strategies for IGBTs, Film/Electrolytic Capacitors, SCRs, Thyristors, Displays, and Fuses.
  • Lead global RFQ/RFP processes; conduct TCO analysis, cost benchmarking, and commercial negotiations with tier-1 and strategic semiconductor suppliers.
  • Develop and maintain long-term agreements (LTAs) and global frame contracts with key suppliers (e.g. Infineon, ABB Semiconductors, Vishay, KYOCERA, Eaton, Littelfuse, etc.).
  • Manage supplier qualification and onboarding in collaboration with Supplier Quality Engineering (SQE) and R&D teams.
  • Analyse global spend, supplier concentration, and market trends; develop dual-source and multi-source strategies to mitigate supply risk.
  • Monitor power semiconductor market dynamics (silicon, SiC, GaN), component lifecycle, and obsolescence management; implement last-time-buy strategies.
  • Drive year-over-year cost savings through volume consolidation, competitive sourcing, design-to-cost, and VA/VE initiatives.
  • Collaborate with Engineering and NPI teams globally to influence component selection and ensure strategic alignment from product concept through mass production.
  • Manage end-to-end contract lifecycle: drafting, review, execution, and compliance monitoring.
  • Report category performance (cost savings, OTD, quality, risk) to senior management on a regular basis.
  • Support global sites (Bangalore, Quartino, Richmond, Frosinone, and others) in executing local procurement aligned with global category strategy.
  • Ensure full compliance with ABB procurement policies, trade-compliance requirements (export control, sanctions), and supplier sustainability (ESG) standards.


Key Performance Indicators

  • Annual cost savings vs. target (PPV, negotiated savings)
  • Supplier On-Time Delivery (OTD) and quality performance
  • LTA / frame contract coverage (% of category spend)
  • Single-source risk reduction (dual-source coverage rate)
  • Component obsolescence incidents and resolution time
  • Supplier sustainability (ESG) assessment coverage

Our team dynamics
You will join a dynamic team, where you will be able to thrive.



• Qualifications for the role
  • Bachelor's/Master's degree in Electrical/Electronics/Power Electronics Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or related field.
  • 5–12 years of experience in strategic procurement or category management for power electronics or semiconductor components.
  • Deep technical understanding of IGBTs, thyristors, SCRs, capacitors, fuses, and display technologies used in industrial power electronics.
  • Proven track record in global supplier negotiations, LTA management, and category strategy execution.
  • Familiarity with power electronics products (drives, converters, UPS, traction, renewable energy systems) is strongly preferred.
  • Experience with SAP Ariba, Jaggaer, or similar sourcing platforms; advanced MS Excel and Power BI skills.
  • Ability and willingness to travel internationally (up to 20–30%).
  • Fluent English (mandatory); Italian, German, or Spanish is an advantage depending on location.
  • Professional certifications (CPSM, CIPS, or equivalent) are a plus.

This opportunity is open to candidates in multiple countries, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage for a location in the European Union, covered by the EU Pay Transparency Directive.
The final offer will be tailored based on your role location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

  • Analyser les dépenses mondiales, la concentration des fournisseurs et les tendances du marché; élaborer des stratégies à double source et à plusieurs sources pour atténuer le risque d'approvisionnement.
  • Moniteur dynamique du marché des semi-conducteurs d'énergie (silicon, SiC, GaN), cycle de vie des composants et gestion de l'obsolescence; mettre en oeuvre des stratégies d'achat de dernière fois.
  • Conduire des économies de coûts d'une année à l'autre grâce à la consolidation du volume, à l'approvisionnement concurrentiel, à la conception au coût et aux initiatives d'AV/VE.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes du génie et de l'INN à l'échelle mondiale pour influer sur la sélection des composantes et assurer l'alignement stratégique du concept de produit à la production de masse.
  • Gérer le cycle de vie des contrats de bout en bout : rédaction, examen, exécution et surveillance de la conformité.
  • Rapporter régulièrement le rendement de la catégorie (économies de coûts, DTO, qualité, risque) à la haute direction.
  • Soutenir les sites mondiaux (Bangalore, Quartino, Richmond, Frosinone, etc.) dans l'exécution des achats locaux conformément à la stratégie de catégorie mondiale.
  • Assurer la pleine conformité aux politiques d'approvisionnement de l'ABB, aux exigences en matière de conformité au commerce (contrôle des exportations, sanctions) et aux normes de durabilité des fournisseurs (ESG).


Indicateurs clés de rendement

  • Épargne annuelle des coûts par rapport à la cible (PPV, économies négociées)
  • Livraison en temps utile du fournisseur (OTD) et rendement de qualité
  • Couverture du contrat par l'ALT/cadre (% des dépenses de catégorie)
  • Réduction des risques à source unique (taux de couverture à double source)
  • Incidences d'obsolescence du composant et délai de résolution
  • Couverture de l'évaluation de la viabilité du fournisseur (ESG)

Notre dynamique d'équipe
Vous rejoindrez une équipe dynamique où vous pourrez prospérer.



• Qualifications pour le rôle
  • Bachelor's/Master en génie électrique/électronique/électronique de puissance, en gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement ou dans un domaine connexe.
  • 5–12 ans d'expérience en approvisionnement stratégique ou en gestion de catégorie pour l'électronique de puissance ou les composants semi-conducteurs.
  • Compréhension technique approfondie des technologies IGBT, thyristors, SCR, condensateurs, fusibles et techniques d'affichage utilisées dans l'électronique de puissance industrielle.
  • Expérience éprouvée dans les négociations mondiales sur les fournisseurs, la gestion de l'ALT et l'exécution de la stratégie de catégorie.
  • La familiarité avec les produits électroniques de puissance (drives, convertisseurs, UPS, traction, systèmes d'énergie renouvelable) est fortement préférée.
  • Expérience avec SAP Ariba, Jaggaer, ou des plateformes d'approvisionnement similaires; compétences avancées MS Excel et Power BI.
  • Capacité et volonté de voyager à l'étranger (jusqu'à 20-30%).
  • Fluent English (obligatoire); italien, allemand ou espagnol est un avantage selon l'emplacement.
  • Les certifications professionnelles (CPSM, CIPS ou équivalent) sont un plus.

Cette possibilité est ouverte aux candidats dans plusieurs pays, le lieu de travail final étant déterminé en fonction du candidat sélectionné. Comme la rémunération peut varier selon le lieu, nous nous engageons à être transparents tout au long du processus d'embauche et partagerons les détails de l'échelle salariale, de la rémunération variable et des avantages sociaux avec les candidats qui passent à la première étape d'entrevue pour un lieu dans l'Union européenne, couverte par la directive de l'UE sur la transparence des rémunérations.
L'offre finale sera adaptée en fonction de votre emplacement, expérience, compétences et qualifications, positionnement du marché intérieur et alignement sur les normes internes ABB.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

R&D Team Lead

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to support the strategic technology direction by contributing your own ideas for identifying, proposing, and implementing innovative technology, software and solutions. Each day, you will assist the Research and Development (R&D) team by executing your assigned tasks and using technical knowledge in a structured way. You will also showcase your expertise by staying abreast of the state of the art and actively applying this knowledge.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Design, develop, and optimize power electronics building blocks and semiconductor functions for traction converter applications, with a focus on efficiency, performance, and operational reliability.

  • Perform electrical and thermal characterization, testing, and qualification of power semiconductors and passive components to ensure robust product performance.

  • Develop and enhance power electronics building blocks for current and next-generation traction converter platforms, from concept through validation and product introduction.

  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams across hardware, software, mechanical design, and manufacturing to solve complex technical challenges and deliver innovative R&D solutions.


Our team dynamics

Our power electronics team develops power electronic building blocks and functions for our traction converter families used in vehicles from trams to locomotives, based on the most modern and reliable power semiconductor and gate control technology. We develop the key components for the evolution of our ABB traction products to strengthen our position in the target markets.



• Qualifications for the role

  • Master's degree in electrical engineering (Fachhochschule/University/ETH), with a preferred specialization in Power Electronics.

  • Knowledge of measurement technology and the structure of test arrangements

  • Familiar with standard Office-Software (Word, Excel), as well as with simulation & programming tools (Matlab, Simulink, Plecs, Spice, Python)

  • Good knowledge of German and English, written and spoken

  • Team player with enthusiasm for power electronics and new product development

  • Creativity and quick comprehension as well as independent, structured, and proactive way of working



More about us

The ABB Traction Division is a recognized market leader in drive technologies for rail vehicles, buses, and industrial vehicles, driving innovation in electrification.

Our comprehensive portfolio of high-performance traction, auxiliary, and energy storage solutions – all managed across the entire life cycle – helps to improve energy efficiency and make transportation more sustainable.

Together, we make a difference for our customers every single day. We look forward to receiving your application.
