titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire d'applications bancaires

descriptionByLocale.it:
VZ è il principale fornitore di servizi finanziari indipendenti in Svizzera. Con VZ Depotbank AG, offriamo ai nostri clienti l'opportunità di elaborare transazioni in modo efficiente ed economico. Mentre stiamo crescendo fortemente, stiamo cercando rinforzi per la nostra squadra a Baar.

• Insieme al vostro team, siete responsabili del buon funzionamento di Finnova e del portale finanziario VZ, comprese le interfacce e i sistemi.

• Lavori su interruzioni secondo ITIL incl. Root Cause Analysis, implementa i cambiamenti, esegue in modo indipendente i test di rilascio e coordinate.

• Ottimizzare proattivamente i processi e migliorare la qualità e non allontanarsi dalle nuove tecnologie.

• Coordinate i dipartimenti e i partner esterni intorno agli argomenti run-the-bank

• Si accompagnano i requisiti dalle specifiche al funzionamento produttivo.

• Laurea in economia aziendale, informatica aziendale o informatica informatica

• Diversi anni di esperienza nel funzionamento con applicazioni come Finnova, ad esempio, come responsabile delle applicazioni o esperto bancario:

• Buona conoscenza di PL/SQL e analisi dei dati

• Alta affinità IT e interesse nei servizi e processi finanziari

• Si lavora in modo indipendente, impegnato, orientato al cliente e proattivamente portare le proprie idee

• L'opportunità di contribuire idee e guidare l'innovazione in una giovane e crescente azienda.

• Sostegno individuale nell'ambito del profilo del lavoro e sostegno per l'istruzione superiore esterna.

• Ore di lavoro flessibili con opzioni di ufficio per soddisfare le vostre esigenze.

• Una società che si colloca all'Università di Scienze Applicate di Lucerna tra le banche più digitali.

• Indagini mostrano regolarmente che i dipendenti classificano il VZ come un ambiente positivo sopra la media in cui possono sviluppare pienamente. Diventa parte di esso!
descriptionByLocale.en:
VZ is the leading independent financial services provider in Switzerland. With VZ Depotbank AG, we offer our customers the opportunity to process transactions efficiently and cheaply. As we are growing strongly, we are looking for reinforcements for our team in Baar.

• Together with your team, you are responsible for the smooth operation of Finnova and the VZ financial portal, including interfaces and systems.

• You work on disruptions according to ITIL incl. Root Cause Analysis, implements changes, independently executes releases and coordinates tests.

• You proactively optimize processes and improve quality and do not shy away from new technologies.

• You coordinate the departments and external partners around run-the-bank topics

• You accompany requirements from specification to productive operation.

• Degree in business administration, business informatics or computer science

• Several years of experience in operation with applications such as Finnova, e.g. as an application manager or banking expert:

• Good knowledge of PL/SQL and data analysis

• High IT affinity and interest in financial services and processes

• You work independently, engaged, customer-oriented and proactively bring your own ideas

• The opportunity to contribute ideas and drive innovation in a young, growing company.

• Individual support within the framework of the job profile and support for external further education.

• Flexible working hours with home office options to meet your needs.

• A company that ranks Lucerne University of Applied Sciences among the most digital banks.

• Surveys regularly show that employees classify the VZ as an above-average positive environment in which they can fully develop. Become part of it!
descriptionByLocale.de:
Das VZ ist der führende unabhängige Finanzdienstleister der Schweiz. Mit der VZ Depotbank AG bieten wir unseren Kundinnen und Kunden die Möglichkeit, Transaktionen effizient und günstig abzuwickeln. Da wir kräftig wachsen, suchen wir Verstärkung für unser Team in Baar.

• Du bist mit deinem Team verantwortlich für den reibungslosen Betrieb von Finnova und dem VZ Finanzportal, inklusive Schnittstellen und Umsysteme.

• Du bearbeitest Störungen nach ITIL inkl. Root Cause Analyse , setzt Changes um, führst Releases selbstständig durch und koordinierst Tests.

• Du treibst die Optimierung von Prozessen und die Verbesserung der Qualität proaktiv voran und scheust dich nicht vor neuen Technologien.

• Du koordinierst die Fachbereiche und externen Partner rund um run-the-bank Themen

• Du begleitest Anforderungen von der Spezifikation bis in den produktiven Betrieb.

• Abschluss in Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder Informatik

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Betrieb mit Applikationen wie Finnova, z.B. als Application Manager oder Bankfach-Expert:in

• Gute Kenntnisse in PL/SQL und Datenanalysen

• Hohe IT-Affinität und Interesse an Finanzdienstleistungen und Prozessen

• Du arbeitest selbstständig, engagiert, kundenorientiert und bringst proaktiv eigene Ideen ein

• Die Möglichkeit in einem jungen, wachsenden Unternehmen Ideen einzubringen und Innovationen voranzutreiben.

• Individuelle Förderung im Rahmen des Jobprofils und die Unterstützung bei externen Weiterbildungen.

• Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Home-Office Möglichkeiten, um deinen Bedürfnissen gerecht zu werden.

• Ein Unternehmen, das die Hochschule Luzern zu den digitalsten Banken zählt.

• Umfragen zeigen regelmässig, dass die Mitarbeitenden das VZ als überdurchschnittlich positives Umfeld einstufen, in dem sie sich voll entfalten können. Werde Teil davon!
descriptionByLocale.fr:
VZ est le premier fournisseur de services financiers indépendant en Suisse. Avec VZ Depotbank AG, nous offrons à nos clients la possibilité de traiter les transactions de manière efficace et économique. Alors que nous grandissons fortement, nous cherchons des renforts pour notre équipe à Baar.

• Avec votre équipe, vous êtes responsable du bon fonctionnement de Finnova et du portail financier VZ, y compris les interfaces et les systèmes.

• Vous travaillez sur les perturbations selon ITIL incl. L'analyse des causes profondes, met en œuvre les changements, exécute indépendamment les versions et coordonne les tests.

• Vous optimisez les processus de façon proactive et améliorez la qualité et ne vous éloignez pas des nouvelles technologies.

• Vous coordonnez les départements et les partenaires extérieurs autour des sujets de fonctionnement de la banque

• Vous accompagnez les exigences de la spécification à l'exploitation productive.

• Diplôme en administration des affaires, informatique des affaires ou informatique

• Plusieurs années d'expérience dans l'exploitation avec des applications telles que Finnova, par exemple en tant que gestionnaire d'applications ou expert bancaire:

• Bonne connaissance de PL/SQL et analyse des données

• Haute affinité informatique et intérêt pour les services et les processus financiers

• Vous travaillez de manière indépendante, engagée, orientée vers le client et apportez vos propres idées de manière proactive

• L'occasion de contribuer aux idées et de stimuler l'innovation dans une jeune entreprise en croissance.

• Soutien individuel dans le cadre du profil d'emploi et soutien à la formation continue externe.

• Heures de travail flexibles avec des options de bureau à domicile pour répondre à vos besoins.

• Une entreprise qui classe Lucerne University of Applied Sciences parmi les banques les plus numériques.

• Les enquêtes montrent régulièrement que les employés classent la ZV comme un environnement positif supérieur à la moyenne dans lequel ils peuvent se développer pleinement. Faites-en partie !

titleByLocale.en: Group leader Subscription Things / Technical Insurance [FR/DE] (m/f/x) - 100%
titleByLocale.fr: Chef de groupe Souscription Choses / Assurances Techniques [FR/DE] (h/f/x) - 100%

descriptionByLocale.it:
Un datore di lavoro forte e preesistente, Vaudoise è uno dei principali assicuratori in Svizzera. Fedele alla sua natura cooperativa e ai suoi valori, incoraggia la creazione di un ambiente di lavoro sano, inclusivo e stimolante, ideale per sviluppare il tuo talento. Le varie missioni che vi aspettano
• Pilota, priorità e organizzazione dell'attività di un team di nove manager specializzati
• Creazione di condizioni per il successo collettivo attraverso il supporto comunitario e il supporto tecnico mirato
• Tradurre direzioni strategiche in obiettivi chiari e monitorare le prestazioni del team
• Sviluppare competenze, incoraggiare l'autonomia e garantire l'applicazione coerente delle regole di gestione
• Sostenere alcuni file di abbonamento e contribuire a decisioni tecniche
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con altre squadre divisionali e partecipare a progetti cross-cut Cosa ti rende unico
• Brevetto federale in assicurazione o equivalente
• Esperienza confermata nell'assicurazione aziendale, con una forte comprensione dei problemi di abbonamento
• Esperienza di guida del team desiderato, con capacità decisionale
• Lingua madre (o C2) in francese o in tedesco, e C1 (min. livello B2) nell'altra lingua, sia orale che scritta
• Masterizzazione di strumenti informatici comuni (MS Office) Se sei anche un leader investito, disponibile, organizzato, forte proposta e mostrare forte orientamento del cliente e un carattere positivo e orientato alla soluzione, probabilmente sei la persona che stiamo cercando! Vi offriamo
• Un ambiente di lavoro sano in una società mutualista certificata "Great Place to Work"
• Prestazioni sociali multiple, compresa la flessibilità nell'organizzazione del lavoro
• Gestione del team e responsabilità
• Valori umani focalizzati sul benessere dei dipendenti Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere il vostro pacchetto completo di applicazione con mezzi digitali (curriculum vitae, lettera di copertura, copie di certificati di lavoro e diplomi).
descriptionByLocale.en:
A strong and forward-looking employer, Vaudoise is one of the leading insurers in Switzerland. True to its cooperative nature and values, it encourages the creation of a healthy, inclusive and inspiring work environment, ideal for developing your talent. The various missions that await you
• Pilot, prioritize and organise the activity of a team of nine specialised managers
• Creating conditions for collective success through community support and targeted technical support
• Translating strategic directions into clear objectives and monitoring team performance
• Developing skills, encouraging autonomy and ensuring consistent application of management rules
• Support certain subscription files and contribute to technical decisions
• Work closely with other divisional teams and participate in cross-cutting projects What makes you unique
• Federal patent in insurance or equivalent
• Confirmed experience in business insurance, with a strong understanding of subscription issues
• Desired team driving experience, with decision-making ability
• Mother tongue (or C2) in French or German, and C1 (min. level B2) in the other language, both oral and written
• Mastery of common IT tools (MS Office) If you are also a leader invested, available, organized, strong proposal and show strong customer orientation as well as a positive and solution oriented character, you are probably the person we are looking for! We offer you
• A healthy working environment in a mutualist company certified "Great Place to Work"

Nel paesaggio idilliaco del Glarnerland è la nostra rinomata istituzione, la Rehaklinik di Braunwald. Ci concentriamo sul trattamento delle persone con malattie psichiatriche. Il nostro team offre una terapia versatile e interdisciplinare basata su un approccio multimodale e integrativo.

Le aree di concentrazione sono disturbi affettivi, disturbi del dolore e del somatoformi e disturbi della personalità

descriptionByLocale.en:
In the idyllic landscape of Glarnerland is our renowned institution, the Braunwald Rehaklinik. We focus on the treatment of people with psychiatric diseases. Our team offers a versatile, interdisciplinary therapy based on a multimodal and integrative treatment approach.

Your tasks

• Therapy sessions: In individual and group settings, as a case-leading psychologist, you treat our patients with a wide range of disorders from the F spectrum of the ICD-10. Focus areas are affective disorders, pain and somatoform disorders and personality disorders

• Rapports and further education: You participate in interdisciplinary rapports as well as in internal training

• Interdisciplinary cooperation: Work in our interprofessional team with other neuropsychologists, nurses, therapists and doctors. Your expertise is highly appreciated!

You bring that with you

• Training: Completed psychology degree at master level, ideally additionally completed psychotherapeutic training

• Interest: You bring a high interest in rehabilitation setting and pleasure in interprofessional cooperation with

• Personality: You are characterized by team spirit and initiative in the rehabilitative environment. Your thinking is constructive, solution-oriented and pragmatic. You also enjoy the interprofessional cooperation

• Language: Excellent oral and written knowledge of German, further language skills beneficial

Your benefits with us

• Mobility grant: Financial support for travelling with the Braunwald Railway

• Attractive working hours: working hours from Monday to Friday without weekends or piquet

In der idyllischen Landschaft des Glarnerlands befindet sich unsere renommierte Einrichtung, die Rehaklinik Braunwald . Schwerpunkte sind affektive Störungen, Schmerz- und somatoforme Störungen sowie Persönlichkeitsstörungen

Notre équipe offre une thérapie polyvalente et interdisciplinaire basée sur une approche de traitement multimodale et intégrative.

Vos tâches

• Personnalité : Vous êtes caractérisé par l'esprit d'équipe et l'initiative dans l'environnement de réadaptation. Votre pensée est constructive, orientée vers la solution et pragmatique. Vous profitez également de la coopération interprofessionnelle

descriptionByLocale.it:
Tätigkeiten In dieser Funktion reparierst du gas- und elektrisch betriebene Grossküchengeräte sowie kältetechnische Anlagen direkt bei unseren Kundinnen und Kunden vor Ort. Du koordinierst deine Einsätze selbständig, bearbeitest Arbeitsaufträge inklusive der verwendeten Ersatzteile und sorgst für Ordnung im Servicefahrzeug sowie im Ersatzteillager. Bei Bedarf unterstützt du bei Neumontagen und übernimmst nach der Einarbeitung an einigen Wochenenden pro Jahr Pikettdienst.
• Anforderungen Du verfügst über eine handwerkliche Ausbildung, idealerweise im elektrischen oder mechanischen Bereich. Du sprichst und schreibst sicher Deutsch, besitzt einen Führerausweis und arbeitest gerne selbständig. Technische Herausforderungen motivieren dich und du hast Freude am direkten Kontakt mit Kundinnen und Kunden. Du bist offen, lernbereit, zuverlässig und hast den Anspruch, deine Arbeit qualitativ hochwertig auszuführen. Eine positive Einstellung und Teamgeist runden dein Profil ab. Angebot
• Wir bieten ein familiäres Arbeitsumfeld mit flachen Hierarchien, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und einem respektvollen Miteinander. Unsere Mitarbeitenden profitieren von guten Sozialleistungen, einer fairen Entlöhnung und einem kollegialen Arbeitsklima.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Activities In this function, you will repair gas- and electrically operated large kitchen appliances as well as refrigeration systems directly at our customers on site. You coordinate your assignments independently, process work orders including the spare parts used and ensure order in the service vehicle and in the spare parts warehouse. If necessary, you can support with new installations and take over pikettdienst on a few weekends per year after training.
• You have a craftsmanship training, ideally in the electrical or mechanical field. You certainly speak and write German, have a driver’s license and enjoy working independently. Technical challenges motivate you and you enjoy direct contact with customers. You are open, willing to learn, reliable and have the aspiration to perform your work with high quality. A positive attitude and team spirit round off your profile. Offer
• We offer a family working environment with flat hierarchies, short decision paths and a respectful cooperation. Our employees benefit from good social benefits, fair pay and a collegial working atmosphere.
